tei:div.tei:p: ༄7/ /rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po'i 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas bsgrigs/bod ljongasami dmangs dpe skrun khang /

— — — ri d+nghaci— wawa —tre skuwane4watwe d+ngha ngecho d+ngha wa co —d+ngha riwa —4ci cho cawabye — wa—bai war+ṣaXwa wowawa skreXwa waXwaskre ོ༷waskre —waririrī phiwa skretre chizhwaspreriwaspre re cici wa rme/ rna dzo — ri sane saca ra 8darjod /dayu rdo /) —posdirna ragal ra d+nghag d+ngha ne — skre — spyi khyab tso sgriske 'askenai— zlone ba snar+sāborī+o/ spuzaṅge dkar tso bustage ā+oṃrdzaded /— — —'gro spyol rdo rje/ ri — — ciwapha ri ༷/warīrī — di lnge—ge —bsdu sgrig 'gan khur ba gtī+oya dang / gtsosnyeg rtsopa/richolto r+sā —snyos/gtso'irgeg—ོpa mestan—lngedzinasna—ོgros —barmestanenyim— — sgro— ོsa 6 / 5 — zla —— / thu ri—— — ri—bsdu sgrigapa/ thungabresnaṣ+ka 'i+od zer/ 0k+ṣiṃ‘bha bstan won/sku dpyid0ṅge—dpaldoci — ri—bzeng / dekon mazorge bsam galke/ shege —rab bsdong sdi+o—ོ/ cuXtwe skuX chiduX —rngoci pyi cho— dzenu dag pa/ bstane sh+kasde spro sgos/— snyosde warībastoske nyi 4——ne/—lko ri bde rī— — —legag dkon mgosbreye dzhamāṃ lge d+ngha skre rīci —chobyeci — 4— —pa hrū shog bzoskrunajuṣ+pe'—ོpa 'gro — lorje dang lagartsal pa we2 — —— kha / ci pyibori rda ju — / — — — / ri ru—shes chor+sā mtsho//ri — wa— — mo — — — — lke — chi ci —pame sgrig lag rtsarme rmeng/ chorta — ṣ+peshes come mtsho/ rigyemeskre chu+osta sgro na / tsho — postan 'dzin/ ———༷ —— — ci— wasnye — — cicudu ——— pro cirī rī ci — ca bsoḍi ne+ems sdo showa wowowo—ne+eciwa— lawaḍil —kasdone+es glu+oshaṃste ḍisdo cilasadige shaci sdodhi/— riri ri— rwa

dpe skrun gsal bshad/rang re'i mes po mkhas dbang dam pa rim byon gyi rnam dpyod lto ba yangs pa'i rtsal las rab tu 'khrungs pa'i gtsug lag ni nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mnyam la ri rab lhun po'i dpangs las mtho ba/ rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings bzhin zab pa bcas 'dzam gling skye 'gro kun gyi mthong chos su gyur cing / de dag ni rang rigs kyi rin thang gzhal du med pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin la/ mes rgyal shes rig bang mdzod nang gi gzi sbyin 'od snang 'phro ba'i gces nor yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling shes rig bang mdzod chen mo'i khrod kyi ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchog nor yang yin/ 'on kyang de dag mi lo brgya phrag stong phrag nang mi dang rang byung gis 'tshe bas rkyen pas nyams brlag tu phyin dang 'gro la khad du thug cing / de dag gi nang don kha cig yul dang dus kyis bskal bas shin tu rtogs dka' bar gyur te/ dus phyis zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi bya rgyur 'gog rkyen 'phrad kyi yod/ bod du bcings 'grol btang rjes dang lhag par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshun/ tang dang rgyal khab nas mi shugs dang rgyu stobs kyi mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar te shul du lus pa'i gtsug lag mang dag cig myur skyob dang / 'tshol bsdu/ legs sgrig/par skrun bcas mdzad de grub 'braṭ+wāṃ mi dman pa thob dang 'thob bzhin pa

dpe skrun gsal bshad/lags/ 'on kyang bya ba 'di ni rgya che zhing zhib tshags pa dang / gting dpog dka' ba'i las gzhi rlabs po che zhig yin gshis/ mdun skyod kyi lam bu kyag kyog kyang kyong dang / tha na tsher ma'i tshang tshing gis yongs su gtums pa'ang 'byung srid pas rang re'i srid gzhung dang / 'brel yod sde tshan/ mnyam sdeb/ spyi dmangs mi sger bcas kyis mnyam las phyar ba gru 'degs dang /blo rtse zong kha gcig sgril/ thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprug bcas kyis rang ngos nas 'go brtsams pa dang bya ba'i sne mo re re bzhin snying rus chen pos rgyun bskyangs nas bsgrubs tshe/ dka' tshegs mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal te byas rjes drud shul thon pa zhig yong thub snyam/ da phan mi lo bcu grangs nang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam dang ngal ba khur bzod kyi snying stobs la brten nas 'bad 'bungs lhur len gyis bod kyi sa gnas grong khyer dang / rdzong dang shang / tha na mtha' 'khob lung khug gi grong tsho dang 'brog dgon sogs gang sar phebs nas de khul du shin tu nyag phra zhing thar thor du lus pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon mang dag cig myur skyob 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun mdzad pa kun gyis mig mthong lag zin byung bas snying khams dbus nas dad gus dang rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu yin/ bod mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas shul bzhag 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig /dpe skrun bcas byas te deng gi spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs dang / phyi rabs rgyud bcas rnams la skyes su 'bul rgyu'i dmigs yul dang / dgos pa/ phan rlabs —2—

dpe skrun gsal bshad/bcas la blo kha gcig mthun thog da lam dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / 'di ga bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib 'jug gros mol thengs mang byas mthar/ khong rnam pas 'tshol bsdu legs sgrig mdzad pa'i gsung rab dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen khag nged dpe skrun khang gis rim bzhin dpe skrun bya gtan khel ba bzhin/ da lan mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs khongs kyi 〈rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rtsa rgyud lung gi spyi gsang ba'i snying po'i 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka 〉zhes bya ba 'di deb bzhi par brtsis nas dpe skrun zhus pa yin zhing / dpe deb 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad zhib tshags nan tur byas khul lags kyang da dung skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig yod srid stabs/mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis nor bcos kyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bstan rgyas kyis/

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigade yang 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang 'tshams shing / thar 'dod skye bo yongs kyi 'jug ngogs dam par gyur pa'i/ chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa yang lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang gtad rabs bdun dang / shing rta chen po gnyis la sogs pa las/ rim par 'dzam gling gi tha gru kun tu khyab pa las/ rang cag gangs can par mtshon na/ mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po mes po bka' drin can rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od snang / phyi rabs 'gro ba'i lam ston sgron me lta bu'i bstan bcos sa chen po'i rdul ltar/ grangs tsam yang bsgrangs par dka' ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ deng dus spyi snartogs la dgos gal che ba khag cig mkho btus kyis/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogasa'adi nyid/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang dang / nga tsho'i dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gnyis mnyam las kyis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du rim pa bstar chags su 'bul rgyu yin/de yang da lta'i char phyi dngos po'i 'phel 'gyur dang / nang bsam pa'i shes tshad cha mi snyoms pa'i dus radisna kyi skyogs mtshams 'dir / smra shes

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigashing don go ba 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi dang / khyad par du spyi tshogs la 'gan khur gyi bsam blo ldan pa'i shes yon can rnams kyis/ bsam blo gu yangs dang /mig rgyang ring po'i sgo nas bsam blo'i langs phyogs ma nor bar legs nyes kyi gnas la bsam gzhig dang / spyi tshogs la rang nus kyis 'gan khur dang zhabs zhu gang 'grub byas nas/ 'cham mthun brtan brling dang shes dpal ldan pa'i 'khor yug cig 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni/ rang cag skye bo kun gyi phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin snyam/de yang nged zhib 'jug khang gi lo ngo bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi ring / gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /mdo dbus khams gsum gyi sa gnas so sor dngos su bskyod cing / dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams srung skyob dang / 'tshol bsdu/ nyams gso sogs kyi las ka'i brgyud rim nang / gal che'i dpe dkon mang po zhig rnyed son byung ba rnams/bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrig dang / bka' gdams gsung 'bum gces btus/ mes po'i shul bzhag /phyag bris gces btus/ shes bya'i gter bum/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs kyi dpe tshogs rnams so sor bsdu bsgrigs dang par bskrun zhus dang zhu bzhin pa las/ da lam mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di yang / ji skad du/ 'jug pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed cig gsung pa'i snying po/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin de nyid thos bsam sgom —2—

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigapa'i shes rab kyis rang rgyud la skye dgos pa yin la/ de lta bu'i thos bsam bya yul gyi gzhung lugs ni/ 'chos skyob yon tan gnyis ldan gyi bka' dang /bstan bcos rnam dag la rag las pas/ 'dir yang brjod bya gtso bo deng dus kyi spyi tshogs la dgos gal che zhing bsam blo'i slob gso la med du mi rung ba byang chub sems kyi bslab bya dang 'brel ba'i zab chos du ma dang / dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi rin thang ldan pa/ yig tshogs nyung zhing blta bde ba/ grub mtha' phyogs su ma lhung ba/ spyi tshogs dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing sogs kyis yid sems nyams nyes su gyur tshe/ blta klog byas na blo rnal du dbab pa sogs dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa dang / rin thang ldan pa'i dpe tshogs zhig lags pas/ rgya che'i mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgyes gzigs gnang ste/ nang bsam blo'i shes yon gyi 'phel phyogs yang phyi dngos po'i 'phel rgyas dang do mnyam pa'i/ shes 'byor gnyis ldan gyi spyi tshogs bzang po zhig phyogs dang tha gru kun tu yong thub pa'i re smon yang yang zhu ba lags/'di yang mkhyen dpyod lhag bsam zla dang bral ba'i mkhas dbang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' yis bskul ma gnang bar ji mi snyam du 'dor ma phod par cung zad tsam du smras pa'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/ 2008lo'i zla 8 tshes 5 nyin phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/de yang rtsa rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsang ba'i snying po'i 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer mchog gis ljags rtsom gnang ba zhig ste/ 'di'i ma dpe ni sngar rdzogs chen shing par gyi bu dpe zhig rtse po tā lar bzhugs pa tsam las/ mdo dbus khams kun tu btsal kyang dpe gzhan pa ma rnyed/ gzhung 'di'i rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis te/ spyi don lo rgyus kyi sgo nas khog dbub pa dang / bye brag gzhung don gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po brgyud tshul dngos dang / de la klan ka spangs pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po la/ rgyal ba dgongs rgyud dang / rig 'dzin brda rgyud/ gang zag rnar brgyud gsum yod pa'i nang nas gang zag rnar brgyud bshad pa'i skabs su/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du brgyud tshul mdor bsdus tsam song nas/ bod du rtsa rgyud gsang ba'i snying po snga phyir lan gsum 'gyur ba las/ phyi 'gyur paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen dang / lo tsā ba rma gnyags gnyis kyis 'gyur tshul 'chad pa'i mtshams nas tshang mi 'dug /'on kyang dpe nyid las gsal ba ltar na khyon shog grangs bdun cu don gsum pa de nyid la byon zhes bris pa ma zad/gzhud gi tshig mtshams la'ang rdzogs tshig bris pa dang / mtshams thig gis bcad de mjug rdzogs pa'i rnam pa ṭ+wāṃsda 'dug na yang / rtsa gzhung dngos kyi

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/sa bcad la gzhig na gong zhus ltar/ spyi don lo rgyus kyi sgo nas khog dbub pa dang / bye brag gzhung don gyi sgo nas rtsa gzhung rgyas par bshad pa gnyis yod pa'i nang nas/ sa bcad dang po'i nang gses gang zag rnar brgyud kyi mjug yang ma tshang ba tsam du zad/ da lam dpe 'di las mngon pa ltar na/dang po shing par du brko skabs nas mjug mi tshang ba'i rnam pa zhig 'dug pas/ rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos 'phro can du lus pa'am/ yang na shing par du 'god skabs dpe cha tshang zhig ma rnyed pa gang yin da lam gsal bshad zhu ma shes/ 'di'i ma dpe ni rtse po tā la'i dpe mdzod khang gi rnying ma'i gsung 'bum gral/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer mchog gi gsung 'bum pod gnyis yod pa'i nang du bzhugs/ dpe 'di snga mo nas nga tshor rnyed son byung yang par rnying yin pa'i rkyen gyis yi ge mi gsal ba mang ba dang / cha mi tshang ba bcas kyi dpe gzhan pa zhig rnyed re byas te da sngon par skrun zhu rgyu ma byung /'on kyang da lta'i char dpe gzhan pa yang rnyed pa'i re ba chen po med pa dang /'di'i spyi don lo rgyus 'chad pa'i nang gses su/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po'i bstan don rgyud kyi dngos po bcu cha tshang zhig bstan yod pa dang / dpe rgyun mi nub pa sogs kyi ched du dmigs te par du bskrun pa yin/ 'dir ma dpe gsal po med pas thag ma chod pa 'ga' shas ni gug rtags nang du gsal bshad zhus te bzhag yod/ de min ni ma dpe sor bzhag gis zhu dag byas te bkram pa yin/'byung char mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyis dpe gzhan pa rnyed son —2—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/byung na dag zhus dang 'brel/ mjug mi tshang ba yang kha skong gnang thub min sogs thugs bzhag yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ da lam nga tsho'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di spyi tshogs thog 'grel spel byed skabs/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis mnyam las kyi sgo nas/ zhu dag dang / 'char 'god sogs rogs ram rgya chen gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang bcas/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas kame bde legs kyis/2008lo'i zla6tshes10nyin la/

rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi mdzad rnam mdor bsdus/rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas mchog ni bod rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel spyi lo 1800lor mdo khams zla rgyal 'phen phyug gi nye zhol/ dge mang skam chung zhesapar yab smug po rigs dge rtse tshe dbang nor bu dang / yum karma chos sgron gnyis kyi srasasu ngo mtshar ba'i ltasadang bcas sku zhabrungs/ sku na phra mo'i dus nas dad pa dang dag snang che zhing lhag par du snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud brlan pa zhig tu bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur ba chos kyi blo gros kyis rje gter bdag gling pa'i rnam sprul bka' 'gyur pa chen po mkhas grub bkra shis rgya mtsho'i yang srid du mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas sngagasaston smon lam dar rgyas las yi ge 'bri klog dang / brda sprod sum rtags snyan gsum/ rtsisarig sogs thun mong gi rig gnas dang / yon tan mdzod sogasagazhung bshad du ma gsan sbyangs gnang / de nas 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i zhabs la gtugs te blo sbyong gi skor rnams gsan pas/ bskal ba du mar byang chub kyi sems la gomasapa'i rigs sad de/ 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang / sems can la snying rje gnyis po phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu'i rgyud dbang med du 'khul te/ 'jig rten srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag la zhen pa gting nasalog ste/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi bya ba thams cad rgyab tu bskyur nas/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugasate rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa/ grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug /ོ༷ ma rnams kyi rjesasu snyegasapa zhig byed

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/dgongs pa'i thugs bzhed nar mar yod thog /gling grub chen bsod nams sbyin pa'i drung nas bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa gsan zhing smin grol gyi gdams pa'ang mang du gsan/ mkhas grub 'jigs med ngo mtshar las rnying ma rgyud 'bum dang / mang dge rab 'byams pa dge legs yar 'phel las byang chub lam rim chen mo sogs gsan/ de nas grub dbang byang chub rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs te/ smin grol gyi gdams pa mtha' dag lhag lus med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing / bdag la gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa zhig yod pa 'di khyod kyis 'dzin par re'o gsungs nas/ nges don gyi rgyal ba'i gdung tshab tu mnga' gsol te/ mtshan yang rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer zhes gsol/ de nas gzhon nu 'jigs med skal bzang las/ dpal gsang ba snying po'i bshad pa dang /sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang dang gdams khrid kyi skor gsan/ gzhan yang bshes mang po'i mdun/ gtum mo rtsa rlung gi skor 'ga' zhig dang / na ro chos drug /gcod yul sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag mang po gsan/ de nas tshe rabs mang po'i rig bdag rdo grub 'jigs med 'phrin las 'od zer zhabs la btugs te/ lo gsum gyi ring brnyes pa gsum gyis bsnyen nas mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du 'od gsal rdzogs pa po'i gzhung bshad man ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byos kyis rdzogs par gsan te/ thugs nyams su bzhes pas sku lus la grib ma med pa dang / khang khyim sogs gdos bcas kun la thogs med zang thal du gshegs bzhud mdzad pa sogs/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam las spang rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du gyur/ dam pa 'di nyid snga mar tshangs spyod rnam dag gos dkar lcang lo'i cha byad du bzhugs shing / nges med kyi —2—

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/gnas su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa mnga' la/ rtsa rlung dang bskyed rdzogs la nus pa thon zhing brtul zhugs chen po dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sa gnon nges shig yin na yang / re zhig sngar gyi jo 'brom yab sras kyi dgongs bzhed ltar/ rang rang so so'i nyams len la gsang sngags las zab pa med cing / gcig pur dben pa bsten na grub 'bras re mngon du 'gyur mod kyi/ bstan 'gro spyi la mdo sngags bshad sgrub cig 'dzugs par phan thogs che bar dgongs shing / lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskul ma yang yang zhus pa bcas kyis/ bstan pa spyi'i 'jug srol gyi rim pa sngar chos rgyal chen pos bkas bcad pa ltar spyod pa mkhan po'i lugs/ lta ba klu sgrub kyi lugs/ nyams len pad+ma dang bi ma'i lugs ltar gsang sngags la byas na/ snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dus kyi mthar yang cung zhig dar rgyas su 'gyur snyam pa thugs la bzhag ste/ dpal sprul rin po che sogs dam pa du mas sngags spyod kyis zab gter bzhes na/ sku tshe dang gter gyi phrin las mthar phyin tshul gsol ba btab kyang ma gsan par/ rdzogs chen mkhan rin po che seng phrug pad+ma bkra shis las gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ 'dul ba'i gnang bkag la tshul bzhin du bslab pas rang bzhin ngang gis nyes lhung phra mos kyang ma gos pa 'phags pa nye ba 'khor dang mtshungs par mdzad/ gzhung lugs rnams kyi zab don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod rlabs che ba thob pas/ snga 'gyur rang lugs kyi lta grub zab mo'i khyad par 'dzin pa la rgol ba gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed pa'i spobs pa rdo rje lta bu thob/sa dge sogs dge bshes mkhas pa du ma dang 'bel ba'i gtam byas pa tsam nas/ med du byung ba'i mkhas pa chen por nges pa rnyed de zhabs kyi pad+mo gus pas dang du len pa byung /—3—

rtsom gapo'i rnam thar/stod kyi gangs dkar ti se nas smad rgya nag glang chen 'gying ri'i bar/ gnas chen gangs brag mtsho sogs nges med kyi dben khrod du mar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te nyams bzhes mthar phyin mdzad/ rtag tu rgyal bstan lung rtogasakyi bstan pa rin po che kho na thugs la bcangs te dbus gtsang phyogs su lan gnyis phebs te rgyud stod mkhan po dge 'dun dar rgyas las/ byams chosasde lnga dang / dbu ma rig pa'i tshogasadrug sogs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyun yod do cog thams cad dang / o rgyan smin grol gling gi rdor 'dzin mkhan po 'gyur med mi pham dpal bzang po las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur mo yongs rdzogs/ lha lung pad ri sprul sku las gshin rje gdong drug dang / mi tra brgya rtsa sogs kyi skor/ smin gling khri chen las gter chen bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ na lespro'i gzimasa'og sprul sku'i mdun ba ri brgya rtsa dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin dam pa byams pa 'phrin las las mdun kyai rdor rgyud dbang dang /lam 'bras kyi skor sogs sa dge bka' rnying kun gyi mkhas grub brgya phrag tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs te/ bka' bstan gyis mtshon gangs ljongs bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad po so so'i bzhed srol ji snyed pa'i dbang lung gi rgyun rnams gsan bzhes mdzad/de yang rje 'di sku na chung ngu'i dus ri kha la rtsed mor g.yeng ba'i skabs shig tu/ bsam yas me 'jigs bzlog tshul gyi kha byang phyag tu 'byor yang btang snyoms su lus pa/ phyis bsam yas mes 'jigs pa byung ba gsan pas thugs 'gyod chen po gnang / yang lha sar chu 'jigs bzlog pa'i lung byang yod pa bzhin de don su la'ang ma gsungs par sbas tshul gyis/ chos rgyal chen po'i sgrub gnas pho brang khar zhag bdun phrag gsum ring phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi ljags bsnyen gnang ba sogs lung byang rnams ma yol bar 4—

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/bsgrubs pas/ de skabs lha sar chu gnod po byung yang bzlog par gyur pa sogs/rgyal dbang pad ma'i 'phrin las kyi byed po gter ston chen po'i skal ba can zhig tu bzhugs/ de nas grub dbang po'i 'byung 'gyur gyi lung byang las/ de phyir na ru dam dben par/ /'du 'dzi yi spros pa bcad bzhin/ /bskyed rdzogs la brtson pa bskyed na//gzugs can dang gzugs med 'gro ba/ /phal mo che gdul byar 'gyur zhing / /rang gzhan gyi don gnyisalhan cig /'grub nges pa pad+ma'i bkar mtshungs/ /zhes sogs lung bstan pa bzhin ru dam gyi dben gnas rnams su sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad par bzhed de phebs pas/ gdan sa chen po o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling du rdzogs pa po chos nyid mngon sum la dbang 'byor ba grub pa'i dbang phyug mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang mjal/ der 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo dang / zab gsang mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid dang bcas pa zhib rgyas su gsan/ gshin rje phug dang tshe ring phug sogs su sgrub pa mdzad de bzhugs pa'i bar skabs rnams la/ mchog sprul rin po che'i zhal snga nas rje 'di nyid la dgon 'dir bshad sgrub kyi srol ka re btod rgyu byung na legs tshul gyi gsung nan yang yang phebs par brten/ gzhis byes kyi bla sprul dang grwa tshang bcas khyon brgya skor tsam la mdo sngags smon lam/ yon tan mdzod/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ dpal gsang ba snying po sogs gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par lung rigs kyi lam nas nges pa 'drong ba'i bshad pa gting tshugs pa mdzad de/ gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che kho na la rag las shing /de nyid yun ring du gnas par byed pa la bshad sgrub gal che bar dgongs nas/ bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis gnas gzhi gzigasasu phebs skabs/ dag pa'i gzigs snang —5—

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/la rgya gar gyi paṇa chen shrī sidha gnas der bzhugs pa mjal bas der mdo khams rdzogs chen shrī sidha chos grwa chen mo zhes/ dpal nā lespro gnyis pa lta bu'i chos sde po zhig rdzogs sprul bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang lhan du gsar bskrun gnang ste/ der 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi phyag len gzhir bzhag thog snga 'gyur nang rgyud sde gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bshad rgyun btsugs te/ mkhan rab thog mar rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer mchog dang / des dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / mkhan chen pad+ma rdo rje rnam gnyis/ de gnyis kas 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che dang / gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba sogs kyis slob brgyud yang brgyud dang bcas pas 'dzam gling tha gru gang sar khyab pa'i 'phrin las bskyangs/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs las/thub bstan spyi dang khyad par rdo rje theg /sngags gzhung spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur te/ /de nyid spyi dang khyad par bka' ma'i gzhung / /dri med phyogs brgyar spel la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes bstod pa bzhin dam pa 'dis dbus gtsang khams khul kun tu mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dpe lung gi rgyun rnams dang / khyad par du kun mkhyen rong zom chos bzang gi gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i dpe rnying rnams 'tshol bsdu gnang ste shing par la bkod pa dang / yang sgos su snga 'gyur bka' ma'i dbang lung dang dpe rgyun rnams ni rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na las ma nyams par byung ba ste/ khong rdzogs chen dgon du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du slob dpon pad ma'i gsung dngos yin zer nas po ti zhig gtad byung ba rmis/ phyir nang grogs mched rnams la slob dpon chen po'i gsung bka' ma'i yig cha yod med 'dri brtsad gnang bas/ sngar —6—

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/man ngag lta phreng rtsa 'grel zhig yod kyang da lta dpe stor nas yun ring song zhes zer/khong nas dpe mdzod rnams su btsal na rnyed rgyu yod dam dgongs te btsal kyang ma rnyed/phyis chos khri'i 'og gi sa rdul rnams bsal te gad bdar byas pa'i khrod nas lta phreng gi dpe cha rnyed pa zhib gzigs gnang bas/ tshig don phun sum tshogs par gzigs te ngesashes thun mong ma yin pa zhig 'brungs/ de'i rkyen gyis rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag snga 'gyur bka' ma'i gzhung rnams phyogs sgrig byed rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po zhig rnyed pa rgyun chags su yod pa'i khar/ lha lung pad ri dgon du zla shas bzhugs skabs rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje dang thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ dam pa de nyid kyis sku gsung thugs rten gtso bor gyur pa'i dngos rdzas du ma'i 'bul ba dang bcas te/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i dbang lung dang dpe rgyun rnams phyogs bsdu byed par yang yang bskul ba dang / kong yul nga phod mi rje'i gdung rgyud zla ba tshe brtan rgyal pos kyang bskul ma zhus/slad nas o rgyan smin grol gling gi gdung 'dzin khri rab drug pa/ 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'i zhal snga nas kyang yang yang bskul ba dang / gzhan yang dbus phyogs su bzhugs yod pa'i skabs shig gi mnal lam du/ rje nyid kyi ma yum de yin snyam pa'i bud med zhig gis ltos dang zer ba la gzigs pas/ gang snang thams cad yig 'bru che phra mang pos gang nas khra chem chem 'dug pa la/ bud med des gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig mdun thad gyi nam mkhar lan gsum 'phangs ba'i mthar bar snang der rten med du bsdad song ba de la/ sdigs mdzub kyi brda thabs gang du bstan pa'i phyogs der hril hril 'gro ba zhig gzigs pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la ri mor gyis shig ces mkha' 'gros brdas bskul bar thugs su chud de/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i skor gyi dpe rgyun dkon —7—

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/rigasarnams dbus gtsang kun tu btsal kyang ma rnyed par yodapa'i tshe/ smin gling du bzhugs skabs cha shasatsam 'di ga'i dpe mdzod du yod zer ba zhig gzims lam byung ba sogs/ lha dang srung masabaskul ba'i gzigasasnang mang po byung bas/ khamasadabus kun tu bzhugasapa'i dpe lung gi rgyun rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdusate shing par la bkod gnang mdzad pa ni/ rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che la/ kha tsam ma yin par snying nasagaces pa'i gang zag chos spyan ldan pa rnams kyis dam pa 'di'i bka' drin shes shing dran par bya 'osaso/ /rje 'di sku tshe mthar phyin par bzhugs na bstan pa'i mnga' thang dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa gor ma chag kyang / de lta bu 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyis ma thub par dgung grangs lnga bcu nga lnga rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1855par zhing gzhan duwazhegasaso/ /slob ma/ dpal sprul rin po che/ mkhan po pad+ma rdo rje/ zhe chen paṇ+ḍita mthu stobasarnam rgyal/ smin gling khri chen sangs rgyas kun dga'/rdo rje brag rig 'dzin chen po/ lha lung pad ri sprul sku/ bla ma pad+ma dam chos 'od zer sogs mang po byon/gsung 'bum la/ sum rtags kyi 'grel pa dang / rab byung gzhi chog/ phung lnga'i rab dbye/ gsang snying spyi don kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka /gsang snying khog dbub/ gsung mgur zhal gdams sogs chosatshan brgyad cu 'a(pod gnyis bzhugs/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nasakame bde legs kyis/2008lo'i zla 6tshes10nyin la/—8—

dkar chagadang po/ mtshan don mchod brjod dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi spyi'i bshad thabs cung zad bstan pa/ (1)gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos bshad pa/ (8)1 rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ (9)1 gzhi rgyud/ (34)1 ngo bo'i gzhi/ (34)2 rtag pa'i gzhi/ (35)2 lam rgyud/ (38)1 lam dngas bshad pa/ (38)thobs lam/ (39)gral lam/ (39)2 lam gyi cha rkyen rgyud kyi dngos po so sor dbye nas bshad pa/ (51)de+o kho na nyi+od lta ba/ (51)dar ba spyad pa/ — 1— (56)

bkod pa dkyil 'khor/ (58)rim pa bgrod pa dbang / (60)mi 'da' ba dam tshig (62)rol ba 'phrin las/ (64)don du gnyer ba sgrub pa/ (65mi g.yo ba ti+ong nge 'dzino/ (66)gnas su stabs pa mchad pa/ (68)'ching zlos sngags dang phyag rgya/ (69)3 'bras rgyud/ (76)2 rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ (93)1 rig 'dzin mi ma yin gyi brgyud pa/ (93)3 khyad par gyi brgyud tshul rig 'dzin mi dang mi ma yin gnyis ka la bathre/da pa/ (94)3 gang zag rna bar brgyud pa/ (109)—2—

༄7/ /rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rtsa rgyud lung gi spri gsang ba'i snying po'i 'grel pa kuno bzang thugs kyi ti+o ka zhes bya ba bsdo/gsadze sa/ /rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rtsa rgyud lung gi spyi gsang ba'i snying po'i 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo//gang gi rang bzhin zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i dbyings/ /kun nas rnyogs bral 'od gsal mchog gi bdag nyid ni/ /srid zhir mi gnas mnyam pa nyid du rtag bzhugs pa'i/ /chos sku'i ston mchog rang rig ngang las dbyer mi phyed/ /chos nyid gang las nam yang 'pho 'gyur med bzhin du/ /phyir gsal rang gdangs ye shes lnga nyid yongs smin gzugs/ /rigs lnga'i gtso bo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol can/ /longs sku'i mgon der sgom pa goms pa'i phyag gis 'dud/ /ji bzhin nyid las ji ltarda 1rdached pa'i rol pa ni/ /

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal srasagazhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chosaskor/thub chen drug dang nyid las mi gzhan gsang 'dzin lha/ /rigs gsum mgon sogs rgyaldosras mchog brgyad btsun mor bcas/ /sprul sku'i tshul bzungs ji snyed mchis la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang de'i rjes bzungs drwa ma lnga dang rgyal bo dzaḥku ku ra dza o rgyan rje dang sangs rgyas gsang / /bi ma be+e ro rma gnyags zung sogs gsang rgyud nyid/ /gsal mdzad 'phags bod pan grub tshogs rnams spyi bos mchad/ /khyad par gnubs zur brgyud par bcas dang rong zom rje/ /kun mkhyen skye dgu'i mig gcig ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /gang dang mi gnyis rang byung rdo rje grub pa'i gtso/ /mtha' yas shes bya gzigs rnams tshe rabs kun tu bsnyen/ /dam pa de kun rnam byang chen por 'ub chub pa'i/ /rang bzhin don dam rdo rje 'dus ma byas pa'i khams/ /tshogs brgyad sbubs nas ji bzhin ston mdzad bla ma rje/ /rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs la bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs//—2

sku 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kagang gi ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /mi phyed rdo rjer 'byams klas bzhin/ /dri med mkha' zla mtshor snang ltar/ /yongs shar mgon des bdag blo skyongs/ /ring lugs legs bshad kun+dha'i dgra/ /bshad bsgrub mkha' la chas pa'i tshe/ /log rtogs mun pa 'jom byed kyang / /bdag blo'i pad+mo rnam par rgyas/ /de phyir de yis legs smin pa'i/ /rgyud don rnam bkra'i dga' tshal ni/ /skal ldan mig gi bdud rtsi rtswa /'di na bayid la ltad mo ltos/ /de yang 'dir gdod ma'i nang dbyings chen po ngo bo ka nas dag cing rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i rol pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i 'char tshul drug dang sgo rnam pa gnyis su gang du'ang bskyod pa med bzhin cir yang snang bar gyur pa las/ de nyid du gzhan rkyen la ma ltos par rang byung gi chos gsum dang khyad chos drug gi tshul du dag pa ye shes kyi sgo ltar snang —3—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal srasagazhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/ba nas/ thog ma'i grol sa gang yin pa la btsan sa zin par mdzad pa po ni bde gshegs kun gyi spyi rigs/ rgyal ba'i yang rgyal/ ston pa'i ston pa/srid zhi'i spyi dpal/ kun du bzang po zhes grags pa de lags so/ de dang chabs cig de nyid dang ngo bo gcig gis bsdus kyang khyad chos rnams ma rtogs pa la ltos nas/ bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig pa dang gang dang lhan cig mi shes pa'i mthu brtas pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa ste gnyis kyis rgyu byas/ rang snang la gzhan du bzungs bas rkyen byas te ma dag pa 'brul pa'i sgo ltar snang ba nas 'gro drug gi snang tshul tha dad pa rnams kyang mig 'phrul ci bzhin yongs su snangabar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na ston pa kun shes rig pa'i rgyal bo nyid/ chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings las gang du'ang 'phos pa med bzhin/ thugs rje ltar 'char ba'i go ma 'gag pa nas rang snang ba'i zhing khams 'og min chen por/ bde gshegs kun dang gnyis su med cing kun gyi sprul gzhir gyur par rigs bdag drug pa'i phyag rgyar snang bar mdzad de/ nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga rgyal sras sems dpa'/ 'jom byed khro bo dang bcas pa mngon par mdzad nas/ dus gsum las 'das pa rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor gsang ba chen po 'di dag 'gro bar mdzad bzhin 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sprin gyis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su khyab par mdzad do/ /de ltar gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ji snyed cig bskor bar mdzad sda ༵sa 'dir 'chad par bya ba ni rgyud

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kathams cad kyi rgyal po/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i bzhed phug /'bras bu thams cad kyi thug sa/ 'dasapa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ ma 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi lam dam pa ste/ che ba'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud dpal gsang ba'i snying po nyid 'chad par bya ba yin te/de ltar yang bi ma la'i khog gzhung gsal sgron las/ rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ gzhan las dpag pa che ba brgyad/ ces so/ /che ba de ldan gyi rgyud 'di ni mtshon bya rang bzhin gzhi'i rgyud kyi gnas lugs sgro skur dang bral ba nyid 'dzub tshugs su ston par byed pa'i sngags bla na med pa nyid yin te/ de nyid las/ mtshon bya rang bzhin gzhi yi rgyud/ /sgro skur med par ston pa ni/ /mtshon byed sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ /'dzub mos ri bong can bzhin no/ zhes so/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde zab mo nyid 'chad byed kyi chos gang gis 'chad zhe na/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung tshad ma/ bla ma'i man ngag tshad ma/ rang gi rig pa tshad ma ste/ kun khyab kyi tshad ma gsum gyis 'chad la/ des gzhal bas rgyud don shes par bya ba'i gnas gang yin pa mtha' dag khong du chud nus pa yang / rdo rje me long las/ lung dang rig pa man ngag gi/ /tshad ma dag gis gang gzhal bas/ tags bya khong du chud par 'gyur/ zhes so/ /de bas na sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad dang / /bye brag gi bshad rgyud sde bzhi la sogs mdo rgyud tshad ma dag gi tshig dum bur bcad nas —5—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/'dir drangs pas gzhan dag yid ches par bya ba'i dpangs po ste/ rgyal ba ni nyes pa mtha' dag yongs su zad pa'i phyir/ rnam pa kun du rdzun gsungs mi srid de rgyu g.yo sgyu dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ des na de'i gsung mtha' dag bden par nges te/ mdo las/ lung ni yid ches tshig yin te//nyes pa zad pasardzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ zhes so/ /de dang rjes su mthun par 'phags bod kyi pan grub rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa thams cad/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal las thos pa'i man ngag tshad ma dag kyang rang nyid kyis tshegs chung ngus rgyud don rlabs po che rtogs par 'gyur ba'i thabs dang gnas skabs su bya sla zhing mthar thug dgos pa dpag tu med pa 'grub nus pa zhig ste/ rgyud las/ tshegs chung don che thabs dpag med//bya sla dpag dka' man ngag go /zhes so/ /de bas na de gnyis ka dang 'brel bar shes rab gsum las gzhan du ma gyur ba'i rig pa tshad mas gzhal na 'chad bya'i don ji bzhin rtogs nus pa yang / rgyas pa'i le'u don lnga pa las/ yangs la rgya che gting zab pa'i shes rab zab pas rtogs por 'gyur/ zhes dang / de phyir blo can rnams kyis brtson/ zhes pa ltar ra/da ni ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul brjod par bya ste/ de la yang spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad tshul so sor yod pa las dang po mdo rgyud thun mongs pa rnams ni —6—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kaspyi'i chings lnga'i sgo nas 'chad de/ ji skad du rnam bshad rig pa las/mdo don smra bar 'dod rnams la/ /man ngag cung zhig sbyin par bya/ /de la man ngag 'di yin te/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /brgal lan bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas/ /tshig don bcas te bsnyad par bya//zhes pa ltar ro/ /de las rgyud sde'i rnam grangs ma hā yo ga spyi'i bshad tshul ni rgyan bdun yin te/ de yang 'di ltar he ru ka ka spo'i rgyud las/ ma hā yo ga'i rgyan bdun yang / gleng slong pa dang sangs rgyas tshul/ /rgyas bshad mtha' dang bshad pa'i tshul/ /dbye ba'i rnam pa gang zag snod/ /bden pa'i dgongs pa shes par bya/ zhes pa ltar dang / a nu yo ga rnams lung bdun gyi sgo nas 'chad pa dang / a ti yo ga rnams spyi don drug gi sgo nas 'chad tshul sogs kyang rgyud de nyid du gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad srol ni chings chen po lnga dang / yan lag bzhis shes par bya ba las dang po ni/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i don gyis ma bshad na/ /chos rnams rig par mi 'dus pas/ /mtha' yas pa yi skyon du 'gyur/ /yo ga'i don gyis ma bshad na/ /theg pa'i ru shan mi phyed pas/ /che chung rim pa don med 'gyur/ /tshig gi don gyis ma bshad na/ /rgyud rnams rim par gsal ba'i tshig /'phrul mi choms pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /dgosached don gyis ma bshad na/ /rdzogs chen bya brtsal med pa la/ /don med pa yi skyon —7—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/du 'gyur/ /zhes dang yan lag bzhi ni/ rig pa rang grol las/ /khyung chen mkha' lding lta bu'i blos/ /don gyi khog rnams phub ste bshad/ /stag mo mchod stangs shes rab blos/ /don gyi sa chen bcad de bshad/ /rus sbal nur 'gro'i lta bu'i blos/ /yi ge'i 'bru rnams chom par bshad/ /mu tig bltar brgyus lta bu'i blos/ /man ngag don du bsdebs la bshad/ /ces so/ /de dag gi spyi'i bshad thabs cung zad bstan nas/ da ni bye brag rgyud 'di nyid kyi bshad tshul cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang khog gzhung gsal sgron las/ phas kyi lan gdab 'bru gnon tshig /khog 'bub sa bcad bzhi ru gsungs/ /zhes pas khog 'bub pa lo rgyus kyi don dang sbyar te bshad pa dang / sa bcad pa dkyus kyi don dang sbyar te bshad pa dang /'bru gnon pa tshig gi don dang sbyar te bshad pa dang / gnas skabs brgal lan gyi don dang sbyar te bshad pa dang bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad pa yin yang gong du smos pa'i rdzogs chen gyi bshad pa'i yan lag bzhi dang phyogs mtshungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang chos lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa sogs zur pa yab sras kyi phyag bzhes du mas mtshon/ 'phag bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis 'chad srol tshig ris tha dad pa mang du snang yang don la ni gcig gi nang du kun 'dus pas na sngon gyi bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi phyag srol mi nyams pa'i ched tsam du zad do/ /de bas na 'dir de dag re zhig btang snyoms su byas nas gong du brjod zin pa'i bshad thabs kun dang 'brel bar sa bcad gnyis kyi sgo —8—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kanas 'chad pa yin la/ de yang 'di ltar/ spyi don lo rgyus kyi sgo nas khog 'bub pa dang / bye brag gzhung don gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rna rgyud lung gi phreng ba las/ rgyal ba rnams ni 'jig rten byon pa'i tshe/ de yis gsungs pa'i lung chen rnams la ni/ phyi rol rgol ba ngan pa 'byung srid kyis/ dang po srid pa chos kyi lo rgyus smros/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs su dmigs kyis bsal nas bshad byar ngos bzungs pa'i rgyud sde nyid kyi byung tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ba yin la/ de la yang gnyis te/ brgyud tshul gyi lo rgyus dngos dang ji ltar brgyud pa'i gzhung nyid la phyin ci log gi glan ka spangs pa'o/ /dang po ni spyir snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud sde bka' ma thams cad brgyud pa gsum ldan dang gter ma rnams brgyud tshul drug dang bdun dang dgu rnams su nges pa ltar/ 'dir yang bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor ba/ /dgongs pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /gang la thug gi bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khyab bdag rigs drug pa nas bdag cag gi bla ma'i bar rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag rna bar brgyud pa ste gsum gyi tshul du brgyud pa'i zam ma chad cing byin rlabs kyi na bun ma yal ba zhig go /de ltar brgyud tshul gsum gyi dang po ni gdod ma'i mgon po nyid gtsang ma'i gnas spangs pa'i 'og min chen por lhun stug po bkod pa'i rgyan nyid du bzhugs pa gang gi tshe/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi gling —9—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal gratshogazhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/gzhi ji ltar byung tshul ni rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu ste/ gong du phyogs tsam bstan pa ltar 'og tu gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'i skabs su zhib mor 'chad par 'gyur la/ de tsam na ston pas/ma yigatu ma gsal1thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs shes dbyer med gsum gyi cha nas gleng bslang bas 'khor gyis bde bas dbyer med ci ltar rtogs tshul dang ston 'khor thun mong gis gleng slong ji ltar mdzad tshul rnams ni rgyud 'byung ma rags pa'i rkyen te gleng slong gi le'u ste gnyis pas shes so/ /de lta bu'i dgongs spyod med du byung ba don gyi zab dbang gsum la brten nas rang gi rol ba dang rang gi rang bzhin ngo bo dbyer med par gyur ba'i tshul bstan nas/ rigs kun dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdul bya'i khams su cho 'phrul chen po gsum ji ltar snang bar mdzad pa ni 'di lta ste/ sku'i sprul pa ltar snang ba'i cho 'phrul dang / gsung gi sprul pa ltar snang ba'i cho 'phrul dang thugasakyi sprul pa ltar snang ba'i cho 'phrul lo/ de dag kyang gsang ba gsum gyis tha dad du sprul ba ni ma yin te/ sku gsung thugs dbyer mi byed pa'i rdo rje lasaso/ de yang 'di ltar dang po la yang gsum ste/ rang bzhin sprul pa dang 'gro 'dul sprul pa dang sna tshogs sprul pa'o/ /dang po la yang gdul bya'i dbang gis dngos gnas pa dang phyogs mthun pa gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni sa bcu'i sems dpa' rnamasakyi snang ngor mkha' zla chu mtshor snang ba ltar longs sku rigs lnga nyid rang gi gnas nas gang du'ang ma bskyod kyang rang bzhin ma 'khrul bar snang —10—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kabs na rang bzhin sprul ba'i sku lnga zhes brjod la/ gzhan du rang rgyud sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus shing gdul bya lam pas bsdus pas na lam 'bras gnyis kar snang du rung bas phyed sprul longs sku zhes kyang bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar dbus na 'og min khang bu brtsegs pa'am stug po bkod pa/shar na mngon par dga' ba lho na rin chen brgyad pa nub na bde ba can byang na las rab grub pa'i zhing dang lngar ston pa yang rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' rin chen 'byung gnas 'od dpag med don yod grub pa sde lngas 'khor sa chen po la gnas pa rnams la/ chos theg pa chen po thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam grangs zhal dang ljags las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las dus rtag pa rgyun du rang snang zhing me long lta bu'i snang bas sgrib pa sbyong bar 'dod de/ 'di nyid kyi le'u drug pa las/ 'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /sogs kyis ston pa ltar kun byed las ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gnas bstan pa/'jig rten mtshan ma kun gyi steng gyur ba/ gnas kyi 'og min khang bu brtsegs pa yi/ gzhal yas khang ste gnas kyi 'og min bshad/ ces dang /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'khor bstan pa/ mos spyod bzhi yis sa las 'das pa yis/ /dang po rab tu dga' ba'i sa mnan nas/ /sa bcu chos kyi sprin gyi sa pa/ma yig tu ma gsal1ste/ zhes dang / chos ci zhig ston pa yang de nyid las/ sa bcu pa yi byang chub sems dpa' la/ byang chub sems te sku dang ye shes bshad/ ces dang 'chad tshul yang longs spyod —11—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/rdzogs sku rang gi ngo bos ston zhes so/ /gnyis pa gdul bya skye 'phags 'dres ma'i don du 'og min phyogs mthun par bstan pa ni/ mi mjed la sogs pa'i 'jig rten rnams su rang rang gi gnas kyi mchog gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi ba'i nang tshan gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga'i thog ma 'og min rnam mdzes chen por grags pa dngas ma 'od kyi rang bzhin las grub pa der/ 'jig rten du sangs rgyas nam 'byon par 'gyur ba de'i tshe/sprul ba de nyid longs sku'i cha byad kyis dang po gnas 'dir byon nas lha dang grub pa dang rig sngags 'chang gi dbang po tshad med pa la/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / pha rol phyin pa'i chos du ma ston par 'gyur te/legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ gtsang ma'i 'og min rnam mdzes par/grub pa dbang po la sogs la/ rig sngags gzungs sngags rnal 'byor dang / rgyu chos du mas tshim par mdzad/ ces so/ de ltar na de'i dus su lam mas sbyangs kyi sems dpa' sa la gnas pa la sogs pa'i gdul bya de dag srid dam zhe na/ 'di ni ston pa rang gi sprul pa snang tshul gyi ngos nas brjod pa yin gyis/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed de'i dus kho nar tshogs dgos pa'i nges pa ni med do/ 'on kyang snang tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin te/ nam mkhas gang du khyab pa de tsam du chos sku dang longs skus khyab cing / des gang khyab pa de tsam gdul byas khyab la/gdul bar bya ba'i yul ji snyed pa'i khams der sprul sku dang 'phrin las kyis khyab na rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'di na yod kyis 'di na med ces smra —12—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kabar mi bya ste/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ spu'i rtse mo gcig la yang /zhing rnams bye ba bsam mi khyab/ sna tshogs dbyibs kyang tha dad de/ de dag 'dres par gyur ba med/ ces gsungs pa ltar skru'i rtse mo gcig gi steng na'ang zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams med par mi sems la de dag kyang gcig tu gyur ba dang rigs su chad pa dang phan tshun 'dres par gyur ba lta bu ma yin pas/ yang dog phyogs cha dang bral bar shes par bya'o/ gnyis pa 'gro 'dul sprul pa la yang mdo sde rgyan las bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bzo dang skye ba mchog gi sprul sku gsum du yod pa las dang po ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya bzo bo'i 'phrul gyis byas pa ltar snang ba dag yin la/ de dag kyang rgyal ba nyid kyi thugs rje las rang snang ba'i tshul/ phal po che las/ ji ltar sems can bsam pa bzhin/ tshad med par ni rab tu snang / zhes dang / snyan gyi dgongs rgyan las/ da ni snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe/ bzo dang yi ge 'i gzugs su 'dug /nga yin snyam du dad par byos/ zhes so/ de la kha gcig 'di snyam du/ gcig de dag rgyal bas sprul pa ci'i phyir yin/ kho bo cag gis byas par zad do/ sems na ma yin te/ rang re la chos snang ba'i sgo gcig skyes pa de yang rgyal ba'i thugs rje kho na las gzhan du ma dmigs so/ /gnyis pa ni 'gro drug so so'i las snang dang mthun par 'dul byed kyang skye ba tha dad du snang ba dag —13—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/yin te/ 'di ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / dge ba'i grogs po dang /dge spyod rgyal po dang / dmangs rigs 'byor ldan dang / gzhan yang dmag dpon dang / shan pa dang / smad 'tshong ma dang / gcan gzan gyi rgyal po dang / las mkhan dang / bya dang ri dgas la sogs pa'i rnam pa ris su ma chad pa dag dang / mu ge'i tshe na nya bo che dang / dmyal ba'i yul du gyad pak+shi ta dang / srin po'i gling du cang shes bā la ha sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa dpag tu med pa dag yin te/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog tu mthong bse gdul bar bya ba yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang gser gyi kha dog tu snang ngo / de bzhin du be+eḍūr+ya dang aṇ+ḍa rnyil dang / spug dang / mu tig dmar po'i kha dog gis gdul bar bya ba yin na/ de dag gi kha dog tu bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten skyong ba dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug dang / lha ma yin dang / mi dang / dud 'gro dang / dmyal ba dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pas gdul bar bya ba yin na de dag gi gzugs su zhugs nas chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas na rang re byis pa'i blo dang mdza' bar gyur ba dang / da dung 'phags pa'i ye shes dang ni bshes par gyur ba ma yin pas/ dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs pa man ngag gi mthil du tshul 'di dag gis kyang gzu bor gnas pa dag la phyogs tsam ston pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni mdzad pa —14—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kabacu gnyis mthar phyin nas 'dul ba rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba 'dren par mdzad pa bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'dren pa stong 'jam dpal dang phyag rdor te/ sems dpa' gnyis dang bcas pa yongs su grags pa ltar dang / gzhan yang bar skabs kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang bcas zhing 'di'i skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du byon dang 'byon par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhing gzhan la yang yongs su snang bar mdzad nas chos kyi 'khor lo yang de snyed cig bskor te 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i tshul/ ye shes nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ kun bzang longs spyod rdzogs pa las/ 'dul ba'i sprul ba grangs med cing / khyad par mi mjed 'jig rten du/ stong rtsa gnyis kyi skur snang ngo / /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul ba'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs pa ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes —15—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/gsungs pa ltar de dag gi zlas drangs pa'i thub pa gzhan lnga yang yin no//de ltar na thub pa drug po mdzad pa bcu gnyis mthar phyin pa'i mchog gi sprul skur khyad med dam zhe na/ 'di ltar gdul bya'i mthun snang ma nges pa la ltos nas/ mdzad pa sna tshogs su snang yang / rang ngos nas rgyal ba nyid kyis sprul ba'i mchog gi sprul sku la bzang ngan med phyir khyad med la/ ji ltar mdzad pa rnams kyang 'gro ba rnams rnam grol gyi lam la dkri bar byed pa'i yang dag pa'i mdzad pa kho na las ma 'das so/ 'on kyang mchog sprul yin pa gang zhig mdzad pa bcu gnyis kho nar nges dgos pa dang /gdul byar snang tshul gcig dgos pas khyab pa ni med de/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'dren pa byams pa mgon po yang dka' spyad kyi mdzad pa mi mdzad par gsungs pa dang / zhing gzhan 'ga' zhig na bdud kyang med phyir de 'dul ba'i mdzad pa yang mi mdzad pa dang / snang tshul yang 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di nyid gcig pu la yang bdud rnams kyis ni bdud du mthong ngo / lhas spyin gyis ni spun zlar mthong ngo / /phyi rol ba dag gis ni log chos can du mthong ngo / /legs skar sogs log lta can 'ga' zhig gis ni g.yo sgyu can du mthong ngo / /nyan thos rnams kyis ni dgra bcom par mthong ngo //theg chen pa phal gyis ni sangs rgyas sprul skur mthong ba sogs mdor na snang tshul mi gcig pa tha dad du yod kyang / don la ni gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol las gzhan du ma dmigs shing / de'i mdzad pa yang sum cu rtsa drug nas brgyad kyi bar ma nges par gsungs ba dag kyang —16—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kasangs rgyas kho na'i mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir mtha' gcig tu nges pa med de/bskal pa skad cig dang skad cig bskal par bsgyur ba'i cho 'phrul mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na mdzad pa ji ltar snang yang gdul bya'i snang ba tsam las sangs rgyas la ni bdag gis 'di'i don zhi bas byed dang / 'di'i don drag pos byed sogs kyi nye ring yod pa ni ma yin kyang chu snod la zla gzugs shar ba'i tshul du yongs su snang ba'i tshul/ phal po che las ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ chu yi sgod du snang gyur kyang / zla ba gnyis su gyur pa med/ de bzhin chags med mkhyen ldan rnams/ chags med rnam par 'tshang rgya ba/ zhid rnams kun na rab tu snang / sangs rgyas la ni gnyis snang med/ 'di la gcig kyang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / ji ltar sgyu mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ /skyes pa ma yin 'ongs pa min/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /skye ba med las shin tu bstan/ zhes so/ 'on kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po re re'i gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams ni mchog gi sprul sku mang po yongs su rdzogs pa ltar snang ba re res 'dul ba yin la/ gdul bya rigs tha dad pa rnams ni thub pa yang mdzad pa tha dad pa ltar snang ba re res 'dul bar nges te/rgyud sgyu 'phrul bla ma las/ lha yi gnas na brgya byin mgon/ /lha ma yin la thag bzang ris/ /mi la bdud 'dul shākya'i mgon/ /yi dwags gnas na kha 'bar de/ /byol song seṅge nyid du smra/ /dmyal ba la ni gshin rje'i mgon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'o na gong du brgya byin skye ba sprul skur —17—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/bshad pa ma yin nam snyam na/ sangs rgyas longs skus 'og min nas thog mar sprul ba'i thub pa drug ni mchog gi sprul sku las ma 'das kyang / de dag gis gang la gang 'dul du sprul ba'i dbang po la sogs pa'i skye ba tha dad du snang ba rnams ni skye ba sprul skur nges te/ dper na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas gcig pu la yang lha dbang brgya byin nye dbang so gnyis sogs mang du snang ba ltar yin la/ de yang brgya byin gyi ming tsam brjod pas ni ci zhig nongs te/ rang res gang zag phal ba dag la yang shākya seṅger btags pas thub pa'i dbang por mi 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /'di dag ji ltar sprul pa'i tshul la sogs pa zhib rgyas su ni 'og tu chos thams cad gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa sna tshogs sprul pa ni/ rgyal ba nyid kyi thugs rje'i byin brlabs las rang snang bar mdzad pa gzhal med khang dang / skyed mo'i tshal dang / 'dun sa bzang po dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / dpag bsam gyi ljon pa dang /gzhan yang gru dang / zam pa dang / skyel ma dang / lhag skyobs kyi phug pa dang / gos kyi rigs dang / bza' btung dang / ngal steg la sogs pa gnas skabs su phan par 'gyur ba rnams dang / mdor na tsha bas nyen pa la grangs ba'i reg bya dang / grangs bas nyen pa la tsha ba'i me 'od tsam tshun chod sems can rnams la gang la gang phan gyi tshul du snang bar dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo rnams su gsungs pa ltar/ yeshes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i mdo las kyang / gong du grang —18—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kapa'i 'phros su/ 'di skad du/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du skyed mo'i tshal dang / nor bu dang / sman dang / rigs sngags dang / nye bar mkho dgu'i yo byad du snang bas gdul bar bya ba yin na de dang de'i gzugs dang kha dog du snang ngo / /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag kyang sku'i sprul pa ltar snang yang / sku ji lta ba bzhin du snang dgos pa dang / sku nyid gsung dang thugs su yang mi 'phrul pa'i nges pa med pa ni med pas na cho 'phrul zhes brjod pa yin no/ /de la 'di snyam du/ ci zhig nam mkhas gar khyab chos sku dang longs sku'i zhing gis khyab cing / de tsam du sprul sku dang de'i 'phrin las kyis kyang go mtsham med par khyab na/ sku gsum gyi zhing khams de gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na ni gsum du bgrang ba'ang don med la/ tha dad na ni gcig la gcig bcug lta bu'am 'dris par gyur ba gang lta bu snyam na/ de nyid 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ spyir gong du smos pa ltar rdul phran gyi khongs na rdul snyed kyi grang dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams gnas pa de dag kyang rdul phran chen por song ba dang / zhing khams chung ngur song ba cung zad kyang med par zhing de dang de na sangs rgyas des 'khor rgyal ba'i sras po la chos gsungs pa'i tshul/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /ces gsungs pa bzhin rang re gnas pa'i sprul sku'i zhing khams mi mjed kyi 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya 'di yang longs sku rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i phyag gi pad+ma'i sdong po'i ze 'bru phra mo —19—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/gcig gi steng na yod par gsungs pa de bzhin du sku'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad na'ang sprul sku'i zhing khams de snyed cig yod par gsungs ba rnams kyang zhing de dag ha cang chung ngur gyur pa dang / sku nyid gtos chen po gyur ba ni 'ga' yang med la/ 'on kyang zhing khams chen por gyur ba dang sku chung ngur gyur pa'i go 'dzol ba dang / med pa la yod par sgro btags pa'i ldem dgongs tsam yang ma yin par phyogs bcu'i nam mkhas gang du khyab pa de srid du sku gsum gyi zhing khams dang gsang ba gsum gyis kyang de ltar yongs su khyab par mdzad pa yin te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ nam mkhas ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /sku yis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /sku yis ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /'od kyis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /'od kyis ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /gsung gis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /gsung gis ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /thugs kyis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ ces so/ /de yang chos sku'i zhing khams ni nang dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzhonanu bum sku'i sbubs/ longs sku'i zhing khams ni phyir gsal lhun 'grub chen po'i rang gdangs nges pa lnga ldan/ sprul sku'i zhing khams ni rtsal snang cir yang mched pa snazutshogs gdul bya'i khams te/ ldog pa tha dad pa gsum du dbye yang ngo bo chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i dbyings gcig gis bsdus pas gsum du bgrang ba yang mi 'gal la/ gcig tu khyab pas 'dres pa la sogs pa'i skyon yang yod pa ma yin no/ /de dag kyang thun mong gdul bya'i ngor snang dbang btsan du byas nas dbye ba tsam las/ don la ni sangs —20—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kargyas thams cad chos sku'i zhing las gang du'ang g.yos pa med na gcig dang tha dad du dbye ba tsam yang 'thad pa ma yin te/ theg bsdus las/bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ gnas la tha dad yod ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'o na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhing khams 'di yang chos sku'i zhing khams yin nam zhe na/ gdul bya spyi mthun du snang ba 'di ni sprul sku'i zhing khams las ma 'dus mod kyis/ 'di nyid rnam par dag pa las gzhan pa'i chos sku'i zhing khams shig gud na yod pa yang ma yin te/dper na chu gcig pu 'di la'ang ngan song gi 'gro ba la snang rgyu de las ngo bo tha dad pa gcig gzhan dag la yod pa ma yin mod de rnam pa snang tshul ni/ dmyal ba pa dag gis khro chu dang / yi dwags kyis rnag khrag /dud 'gros btung du rung ba tsam/ mis chu/ lhas bdud rtsi/ dag pa'i zhing na gnas pas bdud rtsi chen por mthong ba sogs dang / gzhan yang chos la dbang thob pa'i rigs 'dzin rnams la chu de nyid mā ma gīr snang ste/brlan pa'i bya ba yang byed la/ rol bas bde ba yang myong zhing ting nge 'dzin kyang 'phrul to/ /bag la nyal shin tu zad pa la ni spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du ro gcig par snang ba dang mi snang ba'i spros pa nye bar zhi ba de bzhin du mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar la ser por mthong dus ser snang de dung gi kha dog ma yin kyang nad las grol ba'i dus kyi dkar por mthong rgyu de yang de las gzhan pa zhig ma yin pa ltar/ zhing 'di yang rang snang ma dag pa 'di ltar snang ba las don la de ltar ma yin —21—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/pa'i tshul/ dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ btsun pa shā ris bus smras pa/ bdag gis sa chen po 'di mtho dman dang g.yang sa dang ljan ldid kyis gang bar mthong ngo / /zhes zer ro/ sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i zhing nas 'ongs pa'i tshangs pa ral pa can gyis smras pa/ bdag gis ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhing 'di nyid gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i gnas kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bzhin du yongs su dag par mthong ngo / /zhes zer ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i rang bzhin bstan par mdzad pas/ thams cad kyis sangs rgyas rin po che rgyan bkod pa'i zhing khams bzhin yongs su dag par mthong bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ni rtag tu 'di 'dra ste/ khyed rnams kyis mi mthong ngo / /zhes so/ /tshul 'di lta bu la dgongs nas res 'ga' zhing dang sku'i bkod pa tha dad du gsungs pa dang / res 'ga' gcig tu gsungs pa rnams kyang brjod don gcig pa yin te/ dper na zla gzugs chu snod la shar ba'i tshe chu zla du ma la ltos nas tha dad du brjod pa yang yin la/ de kun gyi ngo bo mkha' zla gcig las ma 'das pa la ltos nas gcig tu brjod pa yang mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /'o na sgrib byed yongs su dag pa'i sangs rgyas la gdul bya ma dag pa'i zhing zhig snang ngam mi snang zhe na/ sangs rgyas rang ngos nas mi snang yang gzigs pa rnam par dag pas cir yang mkhyen pa ni mi 'gag ste/ de —22—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka'agags na ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang med par thal ba dang / mdo las kyang / ngas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrib pa med pas yongs su gzigs pa na/ 'jig rten khams dag pa dang ma dag pa dang / sems can dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa dag kyang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen to/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'di ltar rin po che'i khang bu zhig tu mi du ma tshogs pa las 'ga' zhig gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam la mdze nad la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drag po du ma zhig gis mnar ba rmi gyin 'dug pa na/ der mi mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba zhig 'dug pa des/ gzhan de rnams rin po che'i khang bur gnas pa yang shes la/ gnyid du song nas rmi lam log pa rmi gyin yod pa yang shes nas de ma thag de dag gi gam du sprul ba bkyes nas 'di skad/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid med pa dang / mi rtag pa/ sgyu ma lta bu yin te/ khyed cag rnams la da ltar snang ba 'di yang gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam la bden par bzungs ba tsam mo/ /zhes brjod nas rim gyis gnyid sad pa'i thabs la sbyor ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang gdul bya'i 'khrul snang yang mkhyen la/ de las grol ba'i thabs kyang mkhyen nas thugs rjes gzigs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar mkhyen dus nyid nas rang nyid la ni 'khrul ba mi snang ba'i tshul mi de dag rin po che'i khang bu las gang du'ang ma bskyod pa lta bu'o/ /tshul de bzhin du gzigs nas 'gro ba'i khams su sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di dag sprul nas theg pa'i —23—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/rim pa dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa'i tshul rnams kyang gong du smos pa'i le'u gsum pa'i smad kyis ston pa de ltar 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro//de ltar sku'i bkod pa zad mi shes pa'i cho 'phrul rnams mngon du snang ba dang chab gcig cho 'phrul gnyis pa ji ltar snang bar mdzad pa ni/gsung yi ge'i 'khor lo ste ston pa nyid kyi gsang gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i dbyings las skye med stong pa nyid mtshon pa'i yi ge a nyid rang snang bar mdzad pa las/ rang gi ngo bo 'phel 'grib dang bral bzhin sprul ba'i yi ge dag de nyid las cir yang snang bar gyur to/ /de yang 'di ltar kun 'dus rin po che'i rgyud las/ dbyings las a byung a las ni/ yi ge'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'phro/ /zhes dang / ji ltar 'phros pa'i tshul yang / de nyid las/ ka la sogs su rnam pa lnga/ /mgur gyi gsung gi rang bzhin yin/ /gnyis pa tsa la sogs pa lnga/ /zla gam ljags kyi rang bzhin yin/ /gsum pa ta la sogs pa lnga/ /ljags kyi rtse mo'i rangabazhin yin/ /bzhi ba pa la sogs pa lnga/ /zhal gyi sgros las byung bar bshad/ /skyes bu chen po'i smin ma las/ /'khor bar mi gnas yig 'bru ya/ /skyes bu chen po'i dku skabs lam/ /gti mug sel ba'i yig 'bru lnga/ /skyes bu chen po'i sta zur las/ /'dod chags bsreg pa'i yig 'bru ra/ /skyes bu chen po'i dpung pa las/ /rtog pa 'joms pa'i yi ge la/ /thugs las 'khyil pa'i dpal be'u las/ /mtshan ma dag pa'i yi ge sha/ /phyag gi 'khor lo'i 'od zer las/ /cho 'phrul ston pa'i yi ge lga /sku yi 'byu tshad lte ba nas/ /'dod pa —24—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka'abyung ba'i yi ge sa/ /zhabs kyi 'khor lo'i 'od zer las/ /sgrib pa bsreg pa'i yig 'bru ha/ /gsang ba mkha' yi rang bzhin nas/ /cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i yi ge k+ṣaḥ /skyes bu chen po'i spyan gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge i gnyis shar/ /skyes bu chen po'i snyan gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge u gnyis shar/ /skyes bu chen po zhabs gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge e gnyis shar/ /skyes bu chen po'i spyi gtsug las/ /rgyal ba'i yi ge oṃ du shar/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/ de yang lung snga mar a las yi ge gzhan 'phros pa dang / phyi mar sku'i cha las 'phros par gsungs pa gnyis 'gal lam snyam na/ ma yin te/ a ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings chos sku nyid mtshon byed yin la/ de'i rnam rol ma yin pa'i sku dang / gsungs gang yang ma mchis na gnyis ka ltar mi 'gal zhing / der ma zad rang res brjod pa'i dbang du byas na'ang a nyid yi ge kun gyi khyab byed du yod kyang rang gi sgra khong nas 'byung bas na/ de las mched pa lus kyi cha shes gang nas 'phros kyang mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /don la ni gsang gsum mi shig pa'i thig le 'gyur ba med pa las rang snang ba tsam mo/ /de la yang cung zad dog pa bsal bar bya ste/ 'di ltar thog mar chos sku'i dbyings las sprul pa'i yi ge de dag de'i dus su gzugs su grub pa zhig sprul pa yin nam/ /sgrar grags pa zhig sprul pa yin/ dang po ltar na sprul sku'i zhing gcig gi cha shas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gcig pu la'ang / rgya dkar nag bod la —25—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/sogs pa'i yi ge'i gzugs mi gcig pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'dug na thog mar sprul pa'i yi ge de'i gzugs gang lta bu zhig yin/ phyi ma ltar na chos sku'i gsung sgra tshig las 'das pa dang yang 'gal la/ gal te sgrar grags su chug dang / 'gro ba drug gi skad rigs mi gcig pa dpag tu med pa dag mchis pas gang gi skad du grags pa yin snyam na/ de la spyir gang ltar yang mi 'gal te/ gzugs su grub na yang gdul bya rang rang la yi ge'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'dug pa de dang de yi gzugs su sprul la/ sgrar grags na yang chos sku la yi ge sgrar snang rung ma 'gag par yod pa ni ci yang mi 'gal te/ de 'gal na chos sku la gzugs sku snang rung ma 'gag par yod pa de yang 'gal bar thal lo/ /phyis su grags pa yang 'gro drug gi skad rigs ji snyed pa de snyed du grags pa yin no/ /zhes brjod kyang 'gal ba med de/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa las/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ci tsam pa/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'on kyang 'di ltar yin te/ thog mar sprul gzhi'i yi ge a de yang skye med mtshon byed ces brjod kyang / mtshon bya dang ma byed tha dad du grub pa dang / de las de byung du sprul pa na 'ga' yang med de/ chos sku skye ba med pa'i dbyings nyid yi ge kun gyi 'char gzhir gyur pa la zhes tha snyad tsam du btags pa'o/ /de'i gdangs ma 'gag pa las gzugs sku'i rol pa cir —26—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kayang 'char ba'i gzhi'am rgyur gyur pa la ka la sogs pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin te/ spyi mdo las/ gang skye ba med pa mtshon par byed pa'i yi ge la ni a zhes bla dwags su btags so/ /bya ba mtshon par byed pa'i yi ge la ni ka zhes bla dwags su btags so/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin yin la/ de yang tha snyad tsam du su zhig gis btagasasnyam na/ spyir gdul byar snang ba tsam yin mod kyang cung zad sgro btags na/ yi ge'i sgrar snang rung tsam tu ni kun du bzang po nyid kyi dgongs pa'i klong na rang gsal ba rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa'i thugs su chud par mdzad pa nyid sgrar grags pa'i yi ge de ni gsang ba'i bdag pos btags shing /brdar gyur pa'i yi ge 'di dag ni srin po blo gros thabs ldan la sogs pa'i lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin dang grub pa dag gis btags pa/ de nas kyang rim par brgyud pa'i tshul 'chad par gyur ro/ /de ltar snang ba'i yi ge nyid la'ang dbye na/ cho 'phrul sprul pa'i yi ge/ lus gnas rtsa'i yi ge/ pho brang lha'i yi ge/ mtshon byed sgra'i yi ge dang / gzhir gnas kyang snga ma las ma 'phros pa'i yi ge'i gzhi ni gang du'ang grub pa med do/ /'on kyang gnas skabs snang tshul gyi ngos nas byed las ni tha dad du yod de/ 'di ltar sprul pa'i yi ges ni sems can tshad med pa'i don dngos su byed pa'o/ rtsa'i yi ges ni sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i rten byed pa'o/ /lha'i yi ges ni lha so so'i 'phro gzhi byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs dag pa'i don byed pa'o/sgra'i yi ges ni gsang sngags 'grub pa'i rgyu byed pa'o/ de bas na chos —27—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/thams cad la yi ger ma brten pa 'ga' yang mi srid cing / yi ge yang thugs kyi klong nas rang byung la/ de gnyis ka yang sku la rten bcas pas na/gsang ba gsum gyi ngo bo dang rnam rol brjod don tha dad du 'dzin pa ni rmongs pa'i rang rtags tsam mo/ 'dir de dag gi tshul brjod pas lam rkyen yi ge'i rgyud 'di yang de'i dus nas sgrar snang ba'i rgyud du grub par shes la/ gzhan du de ltar ma yin na phyis su sgrar grags pa'i rgyud dang /brdar gyur pa'i rgyud 'di dag kyang 'byung bar mi 'thad de rgyu med par 'bras bu 'byung mi srid pa dang / gal te phyis kyi gang zag phal pa zhig gis khungs med par rong bzos byas su+o chug dang / yi ge bklago pa dang / sngags bzlas pa la sags pa la yang dan 'bras chung bar zad da/ /de ltar na'ang don gyi yi ger snang ba tsam las tshig tu grags pa ni cang med de/ de'i skabs su rgyal ba dgongs brgyud yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar sngon byung lo rgyus dang 'brel bar sgom rim dang sbyar tshul sogs yi ge so so'i don zhib rgyas su ni 'og tu yi ge 'phreng ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'i skabs su ji bzhin 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta bu'i gsung gi sprul pa ltar snang ba'i tshul la legs par gzhig na sngags kyi rang sgra las gzhan pa'i sgra de gang na'ang thos par dka' na tshul 'di ni cho 'phrul med du byung ba zhig go /de la yang dpyad pa de ltar na yi ge nyid sgrar grags pa thams cad kyi rten tsam du gyur pa la ni khyad med na des bsdus pa'i sgra la'ang bzang ngan dang dge sdig la sogs yod dam med/—28—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kayod na ni yi ge yang res 'ga' bzang po dang / res 'ga' ngan par thal la/ med na ni rdzun phra ma la sogs pa'i ngag gi 'du byed mi dge ba dag kyang sngags dang snying por thal te/ sgra rten yi ges bsdus pa'i phyir snyam na/de nyid 'di ltar yin te/ spyir thun mong theg pa'i lugs la'ang chos nyid kyi bden pa ji bzhin mjal ba'i gang zag la ni chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma tsam du mnyam pa las spang blang byed rgyu 'ga' yang med pa'i tshul/mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /ji ltar skye bo mang po'i dbus dag na/ /sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de la mi bden snang ba gang yang med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar nam mkha' dwangs la zla ba shar/ /de yi gzugs brnyan dwangs ba'i mtshor snang yang / /chu zla stong pa gsog ste snying po med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar sos ga'i nyi ma phyed dus na/ /skyes bu skom pas gdungs shing 'gro ba dag /smig rgyu 'gyu ba chu yi phung por snang / /de la brtags na chu ni gang yang med//chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo sde du mar gsungs pa ltar yin la/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi lugs la de las kyang snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i rang bzhin las gzhan du med pa'i lta ba lhag pa bden pa dbyer med spyod yul dang bral bar 'chad na/ sgra dzig tsam la de tsam gyi spang blang byed rgyu ci zhig yod de/ 'on kyang las dang po pa'i dogs sel dbang btsan du byas na/—29—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/spyir khyab byed dag kyang khyab bya dag dgos pa dang / ngo bo dag kyang byed las dag dgos pa'i khyab pa ni 'ga' yang med de/ dper na chu dag pa gcig pu la'ang / sman dang dug gi rigs tha dad du sbyar na khyab byed chu'i ngo bo tsam dag pa las ma 'das mod/ de khyab bya sman dug gi nus pa so sor smin pa lta bu dang / ga bur gcig pu la yang ngo bo ma 'gyur bzhin tshad pa'i sman dang / mkhris pa'i dug tu 'gyur ba'i byed las tha dad du yod pa ltar yin mod de/ 'dir ji bzhin 'chad pa ni/ gzhi yi ge la bzang ngan med kyang / sems can rnams kyi rtogs ma rtogs dang / kun rtog log pa'i nyer len gyis ngag gi 'du byed ngan par bsgyur ma bsgyur gyis las gsogs tshul ni tha dad du yod de/ dper na sems can gyi khams la bde gshegs snying po'i chos nyid kyis khyab tshul zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ bde btagags snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ zhes dang rgyud bla ma las/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin na'ang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la des phan mi thogs par ma zad sdug bsngal gyi gzhir gyur ba bzhin/'dir yang mi dge ba ltar snang ba'i sgra tshig gis kyang yi ge'i ngo bo cung zad tsam yang ngan du ma btangs kyang / ma rtog pa de srid du dge sdig gi nyer len ltar las gsogs pa'i gzhi dang sgra'i rten byed pa yin no/ de bas na 'dir gsung yi ge'i 'khor lo ji ltar snang bar mdzad pa dang /—30—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kachabs cig thugs dgongs pa'i byin brlabs las kyang don ma 'khrul ba nyid rtogs par mdzad pa'i tshul 'chad ma rags pa'o/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir mdo rgyud zab mo'i gzhung la thos bsam rgya chen po byed ma nus na'ang /rang de la mthun par snang ba'i 'khor ba'i chos 'di dag gi gnas lugs ma 'khrul ba nyid ci lta bu zhig yin cung zad re dpyad cing gtan la 'bebs pa'i blo mig ma zum par gyur na'ang / lam 'khyer dang rgyas 'debs sogs blos byas kyi 'ching thag la gces nor du 'dzin mi dgos pa tsam gyi go ba nang nas rnyed par gda' ste/ gzu bor gnas pa dag gis mkhyen par byas nas/ de'i ngang du nyams su len par bya ba las/ kun rtog log pa'i lam du 'khyer ba dag la ni de ltar 'chad pa yang ma yin la/rtsod pa pa/nga re zhig 'dir mi bya'o/ /'o na 'di dag sngon byung gis lo rgyus yin nam/ rjes 'jug gi nyams len yin zhe na/ gnyis ka yin te spyir rgyud dbu zhabs kyi don mtha' dag lo rgyus las ma 'das shing / khyad par brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ni/ dam pa rnams lo rgyus de nyid thugs nyams su bzhes pas grol na/ kho bo cag kyang de kas yid tshim pa lags so/ /de ltar gsung gi gsang ba bas3 gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par rol pa cir yang snang bar mdzad pa dang / gnyis su med par/ gsang gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang las/ cho 'phrul gsum pa ji ltar mngon du mdzad pa ni/ 'di ltar yi ge'i sgyu 'phrul snang ba mdzad pa rnams kyi brjod bya'i gnas lugs ma zhabrul pa'i ye shes garte yin pa de nyid nyid kyi thugs la ji ltar snye/ —

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/mnga' ba bzhin/ nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho bcud du smin pa'i rang gzugs rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa'i thugs su chud par byin gyi brlabs nas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi kun rtog gi rgyun chos nyid de bzhin nyid du ngal bso bar bya ba'i phyir/ theg pa kun gyi 'phro gzhi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po+o'adi nyid la sogs pa'i gsang ba chen po mtha' dag gi /rgyud don tshig dang bcas pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams nyid kyi dgongs pa'i klong nas/ nyid kyi thugs la yongs su mkhyen par mdzad do/ de ltar rgyud sde zab mo 'di nyid dngos kyis gdul byar ma gyur pa rnams kyang brgyud nas gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang rang dang mthun pa'i thub par sprul nas theg pa'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs par 'gyur ba'i tshul gong du brjod pa de dag kyang 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs las shugs la snang bar shes par bya ste/ rang gzhung las/'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang / dam tshig sgrub dang grub pa dang / sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /phyogs bcu rnams su rab grags pa/ /gsang ba'i snying po las 'phros te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin la/de bas na cho 'phrul 'di ni cho 'phrul gzhan dag gi khyab byed dang sprul gzhi yang yin la/ de dag gis gtan la dbab pa'i don ma 'khrul ba lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa dang / de nyid rjes 'jug gis nyams su blang ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa'ang yin pas na cho 'phrul kun gyi mchog tu gsungs pa yin te/ mdzod las/ cho 'phrul rnams las bstan pa mchog/—32—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kami zhabrul phyir dang mthun phyir dang / /yid 'ong 'bras la sbyong byed phyir/zhes so/ de lta bu'i thugs kyi cho 'phrul nyid kyi brjod bya'i gnas lugs ji bzhin pa'i ngo bo ni ye shes kho nas spyod yul las rtog ges dpyad pa'i rtogs par mi 'gyur pa'i tshul/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyis yum la bstod pa las/ so so rang rigs ye shes spyod yul ba/ zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ dpe'am tshad ma'am gtan tshigs sam/ /rjes su dpag pa'i shes rab kyis/ /rtogs par nus pa ma yin te/ /dmus long mkha' la mtho 'jal 'dra/ zhes dang / gal po las/ don dam blo yis spyod yul min/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'on kyang 'dir de'i rang bzhin rgyud don tsam dbye gzhir byas nas tha snyad kyis ldog pa'i cha nas/ dbye bas don spyi'i tshul du gtan la 'beb par 'chad pa la ni skyon de dag yod pa ma yin te/dper nam mkha'i pad+mo dang ri bong gi rwa la sogs pa shes bya'i gzhi ma grub pa dag kyang / ma dpyad na yod med kyi phyogs gcig tu kha tshon gcod mi nus pa dang / tha snyad tsam du dpyad pa'i yul du bzhag pa la yang mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ de ltar yin yang brjod bya gtan la mi pheb par dbye bas ci zhig bya zhe na/ dbye ba shes pa tsam gyis brjod bya ji bzhin par gtan la mi pheb kyang / kun khyab kyi tshad ma gsum gyis gzhal bas dbye chos phyogs tsam go ba de nyid bskyed rdzogs zab mos nyams su blangs na/mthar rnam smin rig 'dzin nas rim bzhin 'phags pa'i ye shes dang mjal ba yin la/ gzhan du gal po las/ shes bya'i nang nas dam par —33—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/ni//gyur phyir nges pa'i tshig yin no/ zhesadon dam shes byar gsungs pa yang tshul 'di tsam du dgongs par zad do/ /de bas na don gyi ngo bo shes bya shes byed las 'das kyang tha snyad tsam du gtan la phab pa'ang / brgyud nas rtogs pa'i thabs su song ba'i phyir don med pa'ang ma yin la/ shes pa tsam gyis rtogs par ma nges pas na snga ma dang yang brjod don gcig pa yin no/ 'di dag la snga rab pa dag mang du rtsod par 'dug na'ang / re zhig 'dir de tsam du 'thus par byas nas skabs don gyi brjod bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag bsdu na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum du 'du ba yin te/ de las mang mi dgos la nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir/ spyan 'grel las/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i shes bya rnams/ 'bru mthun tshig don shes bya'i phyir/ rnam gsum rgyud kyi don du bsdus/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum gyis dang po gzhi la yang dbye na rim gsum las/ ngo bo'i gzhi dang brtags pa'i gzhi/ zhes pa ltar gnyis las/dang po ni khamasnya bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes/ sems kyi dam pa'am sems kyi chos nyid rnam par dag pas/ 'khor 'das yongs la khyab par gnas pa de la gtags pa yin te/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ /rnam rtog kun gzhi ma yin pa/ /rang bzhin med pa don gyi gzhi/ /de ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes so/ zhes dang / rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ /sa rnams sna tshogs kun gzhi ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'ang de/ zhes tshogs brgyad kun gzhi dang bcas —34—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kapa rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin ni dngos gnas pa yin la/ lung phyi mar kun gzhi'i sgras smos pa ni/ kun gzhi'i ye shes la dgongs pa yin te/theg pa thun mong pa'i chos skad du song la/ de tsam du ma zad rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / 'gyur med yongs grub sogs mang du gsungs pa dag kyang / don 'di las ma 'das mod de zhib mor shes par 'dod na rgya gar gyi lta grub rnam bzhi'i gzhung bkod pa dag las rtogs par bya zhing /'dir gcig tu dril nas 'chad par bya ba'i ngo bo ni/ rim gsum las/ngo bo thams cad sems nyid de/ gser gyi dpe bzhin gnyis su med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gser dang gser gyi kha dog dbyer med pa bzhin du gzhi'i chos nyid kyis kyang / 'khor 'das yongs la dbyer med par khyab na'ang / rang gi ngo bo la ni bcings grol gang yang med pa'i tshul/ 'di nyid las/ bcings med rnam par grol med pa'i/ sogs kyis ston pa ltar/ rmad byung rgyal po las/ ye nas lhun 'byams sangs rgyas chos/ /thog ma tha ma dbus med nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin la/ /mi shes byis pa rnam par 'khor/ /'on kyang bcings med bkrol med pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin no/ zhes pas legs par bstan pa yin no/gnyis pa brtags pa'i gzhi ni/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs la sgrib par byed pa'i gnyis snang 'khor ba'i chos su grub pa mtha' dag ste/ de'i ngo bo yang rim gsum las/ ngo bo snod bcud 'jig rten gyi/ snang dang zhen pa'i chos rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang ngo bo'i gzhi rnam —35—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/par dag pa zhig la 'khrul ba brtags gzhi ma dag pa zhig gis ci'i phyir bsgrib snyams na/ bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen nas rang snang la gzhan du bzungs pas bsgrib te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las/'di dag ni bdag med pa yin mod de/ 'on kyang byis pa so so'i skye bo bdag tu 'dzin pa la zhen pa dag ni bdag gi phung po rnams la bdag yod do/ zhes mngon par zhen pas de kho na nyid khong du mi chud do/ zo chun gyi chun mo'am 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyam mo/ /zhes so/ /des ji ltar bsgrib nas 'khrul snang grub tshul yang / pad+ma rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ lha'i bu pad+ma rnam par rol pas 'jam dpal la smras pa/ 'jam dpal/ phyi rol gyi yul 'di dag byed pa pos byas pa'am ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu/ phyi rol gyi yul 'di rnams ni byed pa pos byas pa ma yin te/ sems sam rtog pa'i bag chags kyi snang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ bag chags ji ltar brtas kyang ri dang rgya mtsho dang / nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa sra zhing 'thas pa ltar gyur pa snang ba ga la rungs/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu snang du rung ste/ grong khyer chen po wā rā ṇa sī na bram ze me sbyin zhes bya bas rang gi lus stag tu bsgoms pas/ grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis stag tu mthong nas bros pas grong khyer stongs pa byung ngo / /zad pa sa dang chu bsgoms pas sa dang chur snang ba dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dge slong gi mi gtsang ba'ang rus gong gi 'du shes bsgoms pas der snang ba yin/—36—
