mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal srasagazhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/rgyud don ste/ dang po grub/ de nyid rang gir byas pa gdams ngag gtad de de las rjes 'jug la'ang nyams su len rgyu gzhan med pas gnyis pa grub/ de gnyis ka rgyud gcig gi steng na gnas pas gsum pa grub bo/ /de dag gis dam pa gong ma rnams kyis bzhed tshul mtha' dag dgongs pa'i gnad gcig tu 'bab tshul gyi dogs gcod cung zad bgyis nas/ /da ni rgyud don gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum po de la rgyud ces bya ba'i don 'chad par bya ste/ de yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'brel dang ma tshangs med phyir dang / /phun sum tshogs pas rgyud ces bya/ zhesagasungasapa ltar rgyun ma chad par 'brel ba dang / dngos grub bsgrub pa'i yan lag ma tshang ba med pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag thams cad dang ldan pas na rgyud ces bya ste/ de la'ang dbye na don gyi sgo nas dbye ba gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang / tshig gi sgo nas dbye ba sgrar snang ba'i rgyud/ sgrar grags pa'i rgyud/ brdar gyur ba'i rgyud dang gsum ste/ tshig don bsdom pas drug go /lta ba dang spyod pa'i sgo nas dbye na spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bya ba'i rgyud/ de la'ang dngos dang / bye brag gi rgyud dam cha mthun gyi rgyud gnyis/ lta ba gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de la'ang dngos dang rnal 'byor chen po'am rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gnyis ste bzhi'o/ /de las bla med la'ang bskyed pa sku'i rgyud byin che bar ston pa ma ha yo ga /rdzogs pa gsung gi rgyud zhal gsal bar ston pa a nu yo ga /rdzogs pa chen po thugs kyi rgyud/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med par ston pa a ti yo —90—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'greldopa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kag ste gsum du dbye bas rgyud sde drug tu'ang 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba dang yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na rgyud 'di nyid lta bu rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma lta bu phyi ma'i rgyud/ bshad rgyud sde bzhi lta bu bshad pa'i rgyud/ bshad rgyud rgyas pa lta bu rtogs pa(ma yigatu ma gsal1rtogs pa'i rgyud de bzhi+oX/ /de dag las don gyi sgo nas dbye ba gsum ni rgyud kyi dbye ba dngos yin la/ gzhan rnams ni lam rkyen yi ge'i rgyud kyi dbye bar gtogs so/ /des na gzhi dang lam shes bya shes byed du 'brel zhing gzhi la shes bya'i yon tan tshangs te lam la shes byed kyi yon tan tshangs ba zhig go /de bzhin du 'bras bu dang lam thob bya 'thob byed du 'brel te 'bras bu la thob bya'i yon tan tshangs shing lam la bgrod byed dam 'thob byed kyi yon tan tshangs pa'o/ /'bras bu dang gzhi ngo bo bdag gcig gis 'brel te gzhi la mngon du 'gyur bya ngo bo'i yon tan sku dang ye shes thams cad tshangs shing /'bras bu la de nyid mngon du gyur ba'i yon tan tshangs pa'o/ /de dang mtshungs par lam rkyen yi ge'i rgyud rnams kyang rang rang gi thad nas tshig dang don du 'brel bsam/ gzhi 'bras dang shes thob kyi rkyen du gyur pas 'brel te rang gi ngos nas lam gyi blang dor thams cad ston par byed pa'i brdar gyur pa'i yon tan dang / lam gnad rtogs par byed pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa zhig go /des na rgyun chags shing 'brel ba/ gzhi'am rgyu'i rgyud/ thabs sam lam gyi rgyud/ mngon gyur 'bras bu'i rgyud de gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig ste/ rgyud phyi ma 'gos 'gyur las/ rgyud ni —91—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/rgyun chags la bya ste/ thabs dang rgyu las 'bras bu'o/ zhes so/ /de ltar thugs kyi cho 'phrul gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don thams cad ston pa kun tu bzang po nyid nyid kyis ji ltar mkhyen pa bzhin/ nyid dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga/ rgyal sras sems dpa'/ 'joms byed khro bo dang bcas pa'i sngon byung dngos lnga'i gtan tshig la brten nas rtogs par mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa la rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi bla dwags btags pa'o/ 'o na lam rkyen yi ge'i rgyud 'di yang thugs kyi cho 'phrul yin nam zhe na/ 'di ni gsum ga'i char gtogs te/ yi ge'i gzugs su grub pa sku nyid gsung gi phyag rgyar sprul pa zhes bya ste sku'i cho 'phrul/ de la don gyi yin lugs thams cad brda'i sgo nas ston par byed nus pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa ni gsungs shing thugs su 'phrul ba zhes bya ste gsung gi cho 'phrul de'i mthus don gyi gnas lugs kyi lta ba bzhin gtan la phebs nas dngos su tshig tu brjod pa'am/ 'bras bu mngon du 'byin nus pa ni thugs nyid sku dang gsung du 'phrul ba zhes bya ste thugs kyi cho 'phrul lo/ /des na cho 'phrul gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rgyud don tshig dang bcas pa rnams gdams gtad kyi le'u ste nyer gnyis pas ston pa ltar/ gdams pa gtan yul gsum gyi dang po bka'i bsdu ba po gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin nam/ lag na rdo rjes dri ba dris lan la ma ltos par rjes 'jug tshul lnga'i gtan tshig gis gtan la phab nas bka' bsdu mdzad pa yin te/ khog gzhung las/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis/ thun —92—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka mong ma yin nges pa'i rgyud/ drisalan mi mngon don gyis bsdus/ byin rlabs mi yul grags pa yin/ zhes so/ de nas kyang tshig lnga'i gtan tshig gis sgrar grags pa'i rgyud du gsungs pa la'ang spyad pas don go ba dang /dpyad pa la ma ltos par go ba gnyis su yod pa'i tshul lta ba'i skabs su brjod zin to/ /de la yang 'ga' zhig 'di snyam du/ 'o na gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pa'i sprul pa dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams su sgrar grags pa'i rgyud du gsungs pa las/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi skabs su sgra tshig dang yi ger yongs su ma grags na/ khyod kyi dgongs brgyud kyi khong nas lam rkyen yi ge'i rgyud kyi don thams cad bshad zin pa 'gal ba ma yin nam snyam na/ 'di ltar spyir de'i dus su dgongs pa dang brdas sgo nas don rtogs par mdzad pa la sgra tshig gi tha snyad btags pa tsam ni mi 'gal ba'i tshul lam rim las/ ngo bo snang tshig rang snang tshig la sogs pa gang du tshig lnga'i gtan tshig gi skabs su bshad zin pa ltar/ nang gsal sku gsum gyi gsungs la'ang tshig gi tha snyad sbyar ba yin la/ yi ge yang sgrar snang ba'i tshul du grub tshul gsung gi cho 'phrul gyi skabs su brjod zin pa ltar yin te/ des na denyid du dgongs pa dang brdas sgo nas gtan la phab pa yang rgyud don 'di nyid las mi 'da' la/ 'dir gang bshad nas gtan la phab pa yang de yi dus kyi rgyud de las mi 'da' ba'i phyir 'gal ba'i gzhi ma grub bo/ /'di yan chad kyi rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi khong nas rgyud kyi spyi don legs par bshad zin to/ /—93—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal srasagazhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/gnyis pa rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa la'ang gnyis las/ dang po rig 'dzin mi ma yin gyi brgyud pa ni/ rigs gsum sems dpa' so so nas rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di dang 'di las 'phros pa'i mdo rgyud rnams lha klu gnod sbyin gyi gnas tha dad du gsungs pa'i brgyud tshul te/ de yang so so nas lta sgom spyod pa'i phyogs bzung tshul 'chad du yod na'ang / 'di 'dul bya rang gi skal ba dang mthun par 'jam dpal gzhon nu mdzes pa'i sku dang ldan pa des/ lha rnams kyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par lha grags ldan phyogs skyong la bshad/ des tshangs pa rin chen 'od 'bar la/des tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po la/ des tshangs pa kun grol la/ des tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin la/ des lha dbang brgya byin la/ des lha'i rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad pas/ lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i rigs 'dzin zhing sangs rgyas kyi gdung sob par gyur to/ /spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi sman gyi sku dang ldan pa des/ klu dug can rnams kyi lus sems dang mthun par klu rgyal mgrin pa nag po la bshad/ de nas rim bzhin/ klu mo kha 'dul ma/ klu mo 'dul tshang ma/ klu yid 'ong dga' ba/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ tshoms bu 'bum sde rnams snga ma ltar gyur to/ phyag na rdo rje 'jigs tshul bsdigs pa'i sku dang ldan pa des/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi lus sems dang mthun par gnod sbyin kun tu bzang po la bshad/ de nas rim par/ gnod sbyin grags ldan phyogs skyong / gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / gnod sbyin tshom bu —94—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka'abum sde rnams gong bzhin gyur to/ /de dag mdor bsdus tsam las rang re'i brgyud pa 'di nas 'dren mi dgos pas ma spros so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi brgyud tshul rig 'dzin mi dang mi ma yin gnyis ka la brgyud pa ni/ da lta'i bskal pa 'di ni gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor chos sku kun tu bzang po nyid rnams 'dren stong gi rnam par 'phrul ba las/ rnam 'dren bzhi pa bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa nyid tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su byon te/ rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po las 'phros pa'i sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde drug la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag dgong lo brgyad bcu'i bar bskor nas/ mthar gzugs sku de nyid mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par nye ba na/ 'khor rnams bsdus te/ the tshom chod cig ces bskul bas/ 'khor gyi nang nas rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po ku dza ra zhes bya ba stan las langs te/ dri ba lnga dris pa'i dang po gsang sngags nam 'byung zhes pa'i lan du/ spyir byung tshul bcu gnyis kyis the tshom 'byung bar lung bstan pa las/ khyad par lung cher nges par bstan pa'i tshul las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi/ /mi las skal ldan rig can te/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /sngon du ltas snang byung gyur nas/ /drag shul can zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /grogs kyi sems can dman pa'i lus/ /lang ka'i bdag po la sogs la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar —95—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/'gyur/ zhes sogs lung bstan te mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to//de nas lo brgyad dang bcu tshan gnyis te nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das pa na/ lha grags ldan phyogs skyong / gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ mi las skal ldan dge slong li tsa bī dri med grags pa ste/ dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga nang du mnyam par 'jog pa las langs pa na/ rang rang gi mngon par shes pas sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa dang / gsang sngags bskul ba'i dus la babs par shes nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bya bas za hor gyi yul dang nye ba na dpal phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs kyis bcags pa'i ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse zhes bya ba/ rtse mo na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ges 'khrab par 'gyur ba/ 'dab shod na gcan gzan stag gi phreng ba yod pa/ rtsa ba na sdong po shun pags dang lo 'bras sran sna tshogs su gyur ba'i shing skyes pa/ ngos la brag dkar po seṅges khyi tshugs bcas pa 'dra ba yod pa zhig 'dug pa de'i rtser 'dus nas/ shin tu nyam thag pa'i nga ros/ kye ma kyi hud kye ma klong / /ston pa sgron me'i 'od nub na/ /'jig rten mun pa gang gis sel/ la sogs pa'i gdung tshigs nyer gcig bton te rmag chad par ngus pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsang sngags gsungs pa'i lung bstan dus la babs par mkhyen nas/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la bskul bas de ma thag rigs can lnga la gsang bdag dngos su snang bar gyur to//snang nas kyang chos ston par zhal gyis bzhes te de nyid du gsang chen rdo rje —96—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti katheg pa'i sgron ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag 'jig rten gyi khams su snang bar mdzad do/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo ji snyed cig bskor ba rnams srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis tshig tu bsdus te/ gser zhun ma'i shog gu la be+e ḍūrtswa zhun mas yi ger bris te rgya rang nan du byas pa dgongs pa'i rtsa la bdun gyis nam mkha' la mi snang bar rgyas btab bo/ de'i tshe de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams dngos su 'jig rten gyi khams su ji ltar babs tshul ni/ kri ya'i rgyud rnams wā rwa ṇa sī la babs/ u pa ya rnams ri bo bya rkang can dang bsil ba'i tshal du babs/ yo ga rnams me ri 'bar bar babs/ ma hā yo ga rnams rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu babs/a nu yo ga rnams ri bo ma la ya'i rtse de gar babs/ gnas 'di la 'dod tshul 'as/'a zhig 'chad kyang don la sngon bcom ldan 'das lang ka'i bdag po sgra sgrogs kyi bu mgrin bcus spyan drangs nas/ blo gros chen pos zhus te lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo gsungs pa'i gnas 'dzam gling shar lho mtshams na yod pa de yin zhing / yul de ka sngon srin pos bzung bas lang ka'i yul dang / phyis de dpon seṅges bzung bas seṅgā la'i gling zhes grags/ de na yod pa'i ri de la'ang ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba dang /chos 'dzin rigs kyi sgrub gnas sogs ming gi rnam grangs du mar gyur yang don la 'di nyid yin pa'i lung rig du ma yod pas na lho nub srin po'i yul dang nor bar mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du a ti yo ga rnams o rgyan dha na ko sha'i gling du babs/ de las rgyud sde gzhan rnams ni yi ge'i glegs —97—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal srasagazhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/bam dngos su babs pa yin la/ a ti yo ga ni rgyal po u pa ra dza dang yum snang gsal 'od ldan gnyis kyi sras mo su dharma'i sras rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rjes rdo rje sems dpa' las dngos su gsan pa yin no//gzhan yang ston pa nyid kyis sprul pa tshad med pa dang bcas te gnas tha dad par gsungs pa dang / gong du rig 'dzin mi ma yin gyi brgyud pa drangs zin pa ltar lha klu gnod sbyin gyi gnas so so nas slar mi yul du brgyud pa sogs mang du yod de/ 'di ltar ma ha yo ga'i nang tshan thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu ston pa nyid rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par rol bas rgyal po iṣ+ṭa bho ti chen po la bshad pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rgyal po zla bzang la gsungs pa dang / sto phyogs gyad yul du 'jam pa'i dbyangs su sprul nas 'jam dpal gyi le'u khri drug stong sogs gsungs pa dang / bsil ba tshal du rigs gsum mgon por sprul nas kri ya'i rgyud 'ga' zhig gsungs pa dang / o rgyan gyi yul ghan rdo la'i dri gtsang khang du he badz+ra du sprul nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i skor gsungs pa dang / yul nyer bzhir rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pas bde mchog 'khor lo'i skor gsungs pa dang / ri ma la yar gshin rje gshed du sprul nas gshin rje'i rgyud kha cig dang / dur khrod brgyad du ston pa he rus/ sangs rgyasathod pa/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā yā sogs gsungs pa dang / smre khrod kyi grong khyer dang ri bya rkang can du nang rgyud khyad par can 'ga' zhig gsungs pa rnams so/ /de dag kyang kha cig ni mkha' 'gro ma dang lha klu rnams kyis spyan drangs te phyis —98—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti kagrub thob rnams kyis de dag gi yul nas blangs/ kha cig ni dus de nyid nas mi yul du bhargyud do/ /yang gnod sbyin gyi yul nas byung ba/ dpal rdo rje gur la sogs pa gnod spyin gyi ded dpon gsang ba pas/ slob dpon mthu stobs ra dza la bshad/ srin po'i yul nas byung ba dpal 'byung ba dang dpal dam pa'i rgyud sogs/ byang sems blo gros rgya mtshos grong khyer dga' ba can du slob dpon iṇ+ḍa bho dhi bar ma la bshad/ gshin rje'i yul nas byung ba dgra nag gi rgyud kha cig dang / kha thun zla gsang la sogs pa slob dpon la la'i badz+ra gyis spyan drangs te 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la bshad do/ /de dag rnams kyang rang bzhin gsang ba snying po las 'phros te gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun par nam 'dul ba'i dus der snang ba las gcig tu nges pa ni med do/ /des na sangs rgyas ni rtag par 'gro ba'i don mdzad la/ byin rlabs kyi bka' yang ri dang shing dang / pad+ma dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang / bud med dang / bu mo dang / bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa las kyang chos kyi sgra byung ba de bka' yin par gsungs na/da lta'ang rgyud mi 'byung bar mi sems so/ /de la kha cig 'di snyam du/ 'o na dgongs 'dus su/ nges pa'i theg pa yongs ma gsungs/ zhes phyisasu 'byung bar lung bstan pa las/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nyid kyi zhal bzhugs pa'i dus yan chad la gsang sngags ma gsungs par bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni 'jig rten gyi khams su gsang sngags kyi sgra yongs su ma grags pa tsam la dgongs kyi/ gzhan du na nges pa med de/ sngon —99—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus su bya rgyud dang / gsum ldan gyi dus su spyod rgyud/ gnyis ldan gyi dus su rnal 'byor rgyud sogs gsungs pa dang /thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi zhal nas gsungs pa yang gong du brjod pa ltar nges pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rgyud sde spyi'i babs lugs cung zad cig bshad pa las/ so so rgyas par she+os 'dod pa dag gis ni rang rang gis babs sdo/gas las rtags par bya'/ /'dir ni ma hā yo ga gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul rgyal po dza'i khang steng du ji ltar babs pa'i tshul brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar gong du brjod zin pa'i ri ma la ya de ga'i shar lho na tri shaṃ a su ra zhes bya ba gnod sbyin gyi phug pa yod de/ phug pa de ni sgo zla gam la ngo mtshar gyi ri mo rang byung ba/ phug na rat+na zur brgyad la nyi zla'i ri mo rang snang ba/ thog rim gsum dang ldan pa/ steng na bya ka lan ta ka zhes bya ba chos thams cad thig le nyag gcig tu sgrogs par byed pas tshangs bcas pa/ rtsa ba na bdud rtsi'i chu mig dang mdun na me tog gi snam bu la sogs skyed mo'i tshal nyams dga' bar byed pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dag gis yongs su btud pa/ gang zag las skal dang ldan pa dag gis bgrod par 'gyur yang / phal ba rnams kyis ni nam yang phyin par mi 'gyur pa'i gnas der/ sa ho ra'am za hor gyi rgyal po u ta dz+nya na'i sras skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ zhes bya ba de sngags phyi rgyud kyi sgrub pa la nan tan snying por byed kyin yod pa'i skabs shig na rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba bdun rmis —100—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kate/ de yang 'di ltar/ dang po ri de'i rtse mor dpal phyag na rdo rje byon te/sku'i khyon las 'od sngon po 'phros pas 'jig rten thams cad bsregs nas mi snang bar byas/ gsung gi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu bsgrags pa thos/ thugs las rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig 'phros nas rgyal po'i thugs kar thim/ spyi bo dang rkang mthil las nyi zla'i 'od 'bar ba re 'phros nas rgyal po rang gi spyi bo dang rkang mthil du thim nas snang srid thams cad lto ba nas 'phyo ba rmis so/ /rmi ltas gnyis pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos kyi bgro ba mdzad cing nyi zla la chibs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / srid gsum kha lo gyen du bsgyur ba zhig rmis so/ /gsum pa ni nam mkha' 'od las sprin gser gyi snying po can gyi kha tog ni 'thib/ cho 'phrul 'brug sgra go bar sla zhing snyan pa tshim par ni grags/ rat+na sna tshogs kyi smugs pa ni 'thibs/ rat+na be+eḍūr+ya'i 'od ni lhungs/ snang srid gsal ba'i glog ni 'khyug /rin po che'i glegs bam gyi char ni mngon par 'babs pa zhig rmis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ lo ka ste 'jig rten gyi khams su rat+na 'bar ba'i sgron me sbar ba'i gang bar byas pas snang srid kyi mun pa ni bsal/ bdud rtsi sman gyi char babs pas 'gro ba rnams kyi gcong rnying ni sbyangs/ sems can ma lus pa yang rdo rje rnal 'byor zhes sgra di ri ri sgrogs pa zhig rmis so/ /lnga pa ni/ sprin gyi nang nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rat+na sna tshogs kyi 'od zer can zhig 'bar ba'i dkyil nas rat+na skrug po dpal gyi be'u sgrom 'od dang bcas pa phyi nang thams cad gsal bar snang ba'i nang —101—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/nas gser gyi glegs bam la be+eḍūr+ya zhun mas rgya rang mnan du bris pa'i glegs bam mang po skar mtha' thang la lhung ba bzhin 'bab pa zhig rmis so/ /drug pa ni/ glegs bam de dag la byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang / rig 'dzin lha dang lha mo tshad med pas/ yon tan sgrog cing mchod bstod skor glog byed pa zhig rmis so/ /bdun pa ni/ nam mkha'i sprin gseb nas lung bstan pa'i sgra byung ste/ 'di ltar/ las dang skal bar rab ldan zhing / /rgyal bas 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ /bsod namasachen po dra ma khyod/ /sprul pa ci ltar lung bstan bzhin/ /da lta'i dus 'dir mngon shar gyi/ /'khor bar snying po bya ba'i phyir/ /nga yi cho 'phrul byin rlabs kyis/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /skal ldan khyod la bstan par bya/ /ma la ya zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /dgon pa chen po'i gnas shig tu/ /ye shes snying po can rnams kyi/ /gsang ba bya ba'i dam pa zhig /yod kyi gsang ba nan tan gyi//de la sems kyi me long gis/ /mngon du gsal bar rtogs ma thag /sangs rgyas sa la skal ba mnyam/ /bde ba can zhes bya bar ni/ /'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i/ /kun rig bde ba chen por 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsang chen gsang ba yi/ /dam pa'i mdzod gnyis gcig la ni/ /lha dang mi yi rig 'dzin la/ /rim pas brgyud de grags par 'gyur//zhes grags par rmis so/ /de dag kyang dgongs 'dus kyi 'grel ba lung bstan rdo rje las/ /sku gsung thugasartagasathim pa dang / /la sogs gsungs pa dang gcig go /de nas nang par mnal sad pa na rab —102—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti katu dgyes te 'bor rnams bsdus nas/ rmi lam du byung pa'i lo rgyus brjod pa/ mdang sum du bdag la rmi lam 'di ltar byung / ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod rtse la/ phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang gnas bzhugs te/ sku lasa'od 'phros snang srid byi dor byas/ gsung gi sgra yis lo ka g.yo zhing 'gul/thugs las 'od byung bdag gi snying gar thim/ nyi zla spyi bo rkang pa'i mthil du nub/ bdag gi lto nas snang srid 'phyo ba rmis/ dang po'i rmis ltas bag chags sbyong ba'i rtags/ de nas bdag la sangs rgyas mang po rnams/ med byung gsang ba'i don la 'gro ba mdzad/ ces sogs gsungs te gong gi rmi lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa dag kyang brjod nas/ rmi lam 'di dag dang sbyar na bdag nges par skal ba dang ldan par nges so zhes gsungs pas/'khor rnams kyis kyang de ltar legs so a la la zhes ngo mtshar du gsol te/ yang bka' stsal pa/ de ltar yin na pho brang gi rtse mor phyin la cho 'phrul gyi sa de la dmigs pa bcas te/ mchod pa dang sgrub pa chen po zhig byas na dga' ba chen po zhig skye bar nges pas/ bdag yang thog tu gshegs so gsungs te byon pa las/ rmi lam du ji ltar byon pa'i ngos shig la/ rat+na smug po las grub pa'i badz+ra pā ṇi'i sku khru gang pa zhig 'dug pas rgyal po dgye nas phyag dang bskor ba byas te tshigs su bcad pa/ sngon tshe gang nas bsgrub pa yi/ /las kyis mjal ba'i lha mchog ni/ /bskal par gzhal yang mi gtang ngo / /'dren pa mchog dpal la sogs grangs/ /mos pa'i gzungs kyi lha mchog 'dzin/ zhes gsol nas sku de nyid kyis —103—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/sgrub rten byas te gnas der zla ba bdun du bsgrubs pas/ rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams rmi lam du ji ltar byung ba bzhin dngos su babs so/ /der rgyal po dgyes bzhin nang du spyan drangs te zhal phyes nas bklags pas tshig gcig kyang brda ma mjal bas som nyir gyur te/ e ma ho sngags kyi tshul rtags dang sbyar na glegs bam 'di dag las ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i don chen po zhig 'byur bar nges te/ bdag gis mi rtogs pa ci nyes snyam du bshum mo/ /de nas cung zad cig nas the tshom zhi nas/ lo ka 'di na 'di dag brda 'jal ba su yod ces bsgrags pas/ za hor rgyal po u pa rā dza zhes bya ba mkhyen pa che bar yod do zhesazer nas/ pho nya ba brdzangs nas lo rgyus zhib tu zhus te spyan drangs pas ma gnang ste/ gal te bdag gis ma shes na der phyin pa la don med dgongs nas tshur skyol zhig ces smras so/ /de nas pho nya rnams kyis de tshul rgyal po la bsnyad pas/ thugs la 'thad bzhin glegs bam rnams mchod pa'i bye brag du ma dang bcas glang po che la bskal te bskyal lo/ /des kyang brda ma mjal nas/ bdag gis spyod yul du ma gyur pas rgyal po nyid kyi thugs kyis rjes su dpags 'tshal zhes slar brdzangs so/ /yang khyi'i rgyal po lag thung dang yum skra'i lwa ba can gnyis kyi bu dge slong ku ku rā dza zhes bya ba tshe lo stong thub pa sangs rgyas rin chen ming gi sprul pa zhig yod ces thos nas de la yang sngar ltar brdzangs pas brda ma mjal bar slar bskyal lo/ /de nas rgyal po nyid kyis sgrib sbyangs dang tshogs gsog rgya chen po bgyis te brtags —104—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kapas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u rtogs nas de bzhin bsgrub pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal dngos su gzigs te/ rigs kyi bu dngos grub ci 'dod gsungs pa la/ glegs bam thams cad kyi don rtogs par gsol bas rigs kyi bu de ltar na rang gi phung po sbyongs shig /khyod kyi ston pa gsang ba'i bdag po yin gyi/ des don ma lus pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas dga' ba chen po skyes te bskyed rim gyis phung po sbyangs pas sa dag kyang cher g.yos te/ badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas/ brtul zhugs mdzad bzhin rdo rje nam mkha' la spar nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ rdo rje 'dul ba la sogs pa'i tshig sngags dang spong len brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang / dge bar bskur na nyes pa med/ la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dag brjod pas lo ka'i dregs pa can thams cad 'khor du bsdus/ rdo rje gsang ba'i ming so sor btags nas lung gsang sgor phye ste/ dam pa'i mdzod sum brgya cher bshad pa rnams/ rgyud yan lag bco brgyad du bsdus nas gsungs so/ de skad du'ang rgyal po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam rnam bkod las/ shar phyogs iṇ+ḍa'i lung pa na/ /rgya lung rdo rje brtsegs pa mā /rigs can iṇ+ḍa bhu ti bas/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos mngon bstan pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sgrub pa yang / /tshom bu lnga bcu stong dang bcas/ /phyag na rdo rje mngon grub te/ /spong len brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang / /dge bar bskur na sdig pa med//de nas sa la reg par byas/ zhes gsungs so/ /de la tan+t+ra sde bco —105—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chosaskor/brgyad ni/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'i nang gses dbye ba'i bco lnga dang / spyi rgyud gsum ste bco brgyad do/ /sku'i sku rgyud glang po rab 'bog /sku'i gsung rgyud glang po chur 'jug /sku'i thugs rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi sku rgyud ri bo brtsegs pa/ gsung gi gsung rgyud pad+ma dbang chen/ gsung gi thugs rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi sku rgyud rtse mo 'dus pa/ thugs kyi gsung rgyud gcig las 'phros pa/ thugs kyi thugs rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi sku rgyud sgron ma 'bar ba/yon tan gyi gsung rgyud bdud rtsi sa ma ya 'bum sde/ yon tan gyi thugs rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ 'phrin las kyi sku rgyud dpal 'phreng dkar mo/'phrin las kyi gsung rgyud ma mo rgyud lung / 'phrin las kyi thugs rgyud ta ma la 'bum sde/ spyi'i sku rgyud thabs zhags/ spyi'i gsung rgyud sa ma ya bkod pa/ spyi'i thugs rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba'o/ /de las sgyu 'phrul gyi nang gses 'og tu 'chad do/ 'di dag gi dbye ba la'ang dbye tshul mang du snang ba kun yin mod de/ 'dir kun mkhyen chos rjes bka' btsan par bzung ngo / /de ltar tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad po rgyal bo dzas/ slob dpon ku ku rā dza tshom bu 'bum sde la gsungs/ des rgyal po in+t+ra bo dhi chen po 'khor tshom bu khri dang bcas pa la gsungs/ des sedha rā dza tshom bu stong la/ des u pa rā dza tshom bu lnga brgya la/ des sras mo go ma 'khor tshom bu brgya dang bcas pa la gsungs te/ de thams cad kyis tshom bu tshogs sgrub mdzad pas dngos su rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs so/ 'di dag la 'ga' zhig slob —106—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kadapon ku ku rā dzas rtogs nas rgyal po la bshad zer ba sogs 'chad lugs mang du yod pa yang / 'jig rten pas rtog pa bsal phyir de ltar yang rung mod de/ 'dir ni rgyal po nyid kyi gsungs pa'i lung snga ma dang /sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam rim du'ang / gsang ba'i bdag po mngon gshegs nas/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang / /mi las skal ldan 'dus pa las/ /dbang pos ji ltar lung bstan dus/ /rgyal bu rig can ltas shar ba/ /'brel bas snang ba mngon rtags pas/ /thugs kyi sgrub pa mngon rtogs te/ /de nyid bsgoms nas de nyid 'grub/ /bstan pa'i dngos grub de nas thob/ /don dam bcud kyis de nas rgyas/ /'dod pa'i bsam pa de nas 'grub/ /smon pa'i lha dang de ru mjal/ /de nas rdo rje gdan steng gi//'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /pho brang rin chen dam pa der/ /bkra shis pa yi khang pa sa /ku ku rā dza in+t+ra bo dhi dang / /sidha u pa rā dza dang / /sras mo go ma sa la sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang thob nas/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon bsgrubs te/ /rdo rje 'chang sar mngon du gshegs/ zhes sogs gsungs pa nges pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di yan chad tshom bu'i zhabor dang bcas te dngos su rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs shing rig pa khyad par can gyi brgyud pa zab ma chad pas rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud par 'dren pa yin te/ gzhan du na rig 'dzin brda rgyud ces grags pa ni rgyal ba rigs lngas rgyal sras sems dpa' la brdas sgo nas chos ston pa de la zer yang / de ni 'dir rgyal ba dgongs brda'i brgyud pa —107—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chosaskor/zhes rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi gral du bshad zin la/ de nas brgyud pa'i khyad par gong du smos pa'i rig 'dzin mi ma yin rnams kyang lha klu gnod sbyin so so'i tshom bu 'bum sde'i bar rig 'dzin gyi brgyud par gsungs pas na 'dir mi'i rig 'dzin rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral nas bton pa la dgos pa gzhan med do/ /des na 'ga' zhig gis gsang ba'i bdag po'i rigs can lnga la gsungs pa rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa dang /rgyal po dzaḥnas gang zag snyan brgyud du bshad pa cung mi legs so/ 'on kyang kun mkhyen chen po dang / mkhan chen chos dpal rgya mtsho yang snga rab pa 'ga' zhig gi phyag bzhes kyi rjes su 'brang nas dngos su sa bcad de ltar mdzad kyang / 'di yan chad rig 'dzin gyi brgyud pa sha rtag go /zhes tshig zin kyis bstan pa yin no/ /desan kho bo ni tshig de tha dad drangs su khas blangs nas 'di yan chad rag pa'i brgyud par 'chad do/ /'o na dngos su rig 'dzin gyis la gshegs pa phyis su'ang 'ga' zhig byung 'dug pa'i/ de dag kyang rig 'dzin brgyud par 'dren nam zhe na/ de ni ma nges te/ gang zag rang ngos nasarig 'dzin gyi brgyud par ma zad/ rgyud don rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi tshul du rtogs pa'ang srid tshul gong du brjod pa ltar yin mod de/ 'dir tshom bu'i 'khor dang bcas te rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs pa'i brgyud pa zam ma chad par byung ba'i sa mtshams dmigs kyis bsal bas na ci yang mi 'gal lo/ /yang mkhan chen rin po ches/ rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams rgyal po'i sgrub khang gi steng phu—108—

sku 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugasakyi ti ka'adir babs pa mi 'thad de/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu ba'i 'grel par za hor gyi yul nyid du babs par gsungs pa'i phyir gsungs kyang /'gal bar ma mthong te/ spyir za hor gyi yul de rgya gar gyi shar phyogs na yod cing / 'dir shar lho'i tshig zin gyis lang ka'i yul gling de de'i lho phyogs na yod pa grub te/ thug sgrub rin po che 'bar ba las/ za hor yul zhes pa de/ /rgya mtsho'i gling gi ma ha do/ /gnas pa 'dzam gling shar na gnas/ /rgya mtsho'i gling la brgyud ma sa /srin po lang ka mgrin bcu'i yul/ /lang ka pu ra dag dang 'brel/ /srin po srin mo sha za rnams/ /kun la dbang bsgyur longs spyod che/ zhes so/ /des na za hor gyi nye 'khor na yod cing mi dang srin po phan tshun rgyu 'dul ma chad pas dang / za hor rgyal po nyid kyi sgrub gnas thun mong ma yin par gyur bas na/ phyogs rag bsdus tsam du za hor yul gling che ba'i dbang du byas te/ rgya gar shar phyogs za hor gyi yul du babs zhes brjod kyang mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gang zag rna bar brgyud pa ni/ sras mo ko ma sa las khyi'i rgyal po ku ku rā dza ste/ ku ku rā dza phyi ma slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba gsum la bshad/ ku ku rā dzas/ ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub dang drang srong bha shi ta gnyis la bshad/ snga mas rdo rje bzhad pa la/ de dang bha shi ta gnyis kas za hor gyi rgyal po pra bha ha sti la bshad/ des o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa la gsungs pa'i rgyud tshul gcig dang / yang sgeg pa rdo rje dang sangs rgyas gsang ba gnyis kas paṇa —109—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras khan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/chen bi ma la mi tra la bshad de de nas brgyud tshul gcig te/ brgyud pa'i babs lugs gnyis po bod du ji ltar byung tshul ni/ gangs can gyi khrod 'dir shākya li tsa ba'i rigs las chad pa'i rgyal rabs rim par byung ba nyer lnga pa na/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa lha tho ri snyan shal zhes bya ba byon te/ de'i ring la mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa dang spang bskor phyag rgya pa la sogs pa pho brang gi steng du babs te dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po zhes grags pa dbu gtsug na a mi rde lnga'i zhal dngos su yod pa de byon nas dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga 'das pa na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan zhes bya ba byon nas/ slob dpon pad+ma dang bi ma la sogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya rtsa brgyad bod du spyan drangs/ be+e ro tsa na dang ska cog rma gnyags la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyis lo tsā bslab nas/'phags yul na bzhugs so 'tshal gyi bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad ma lus par bsgyur nas dam pa'i chos dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin no/ /des na spyir sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde drug /bye brag tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad kyi nang gser ji ltar bsgyur ba ni 'dir brjod du mi lang la/ khyad par sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skor la/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad bshad rgyud sde bzhi/ de dag gi man ngag phra mo drug cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa bsgyur ba yin no/ /de las sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang snang bden pa —110—

sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti kadabyer med du ston pa rdo rjes sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ las tshogs rgyas par ston pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ sde snod yongs la khyab par ston pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyas par ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad pa/ 'phrin las rgyas par ston pa bzhi bcu pa/ dbang gtso bor ston pa bla ma/ yon tan mtha' phyin bar ston pa brgyad cu pa/ dam tshig mchog tu ston pa le lag dang brgyad do/ /bshad rgyud sde bzhi ni grol lam rim gyis dang cig car du ston pa ye shes snying po dang rdo rje me long thabs lam rim gyis dang cig car ston pa sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho dang thal ba ste bzhi'o/ /'di'i grangs la dbye tshul mi gcig pa gzhan dag kyang yod do/ /de ltar sgyu 'phrul sde bcu gnyis po phal cher rma gnyags kyis bsgyur kyang /'dir sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba'i snying po ni snga phyir lan gsum bsgyur te/ dang po ni dus der 'phags yul gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba bod du spyan drangs pas/ gangs ri ti se'i bar byon nas rten 'brel gyi gnad zhig gis de gar gdan 'jag pa na/ bod kyi rgyal pos skyes chen po dang bcas te paṇa chen be+e ro tsa na der brdzangs pas slob dpon dgyes bzhin smin grol gyi gdams pa spyi dang bye brag gi sgyu 'phrul 'di nyid kyi skor gnang nas/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam rim du grags pa de/ de'i dus su gsungs nas rgyal po la skyes lan gyi tshul du bskur ba yin skad/ 'di la sangs rgyas gsang ba dang be+e ro'i snga 'gyur zer/ gnyis pa ni o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod du spyan drangs pa'i skabs su —111—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal srasagazhan phan mtha' yasakyi gsung chos skor/gnyags dz+nya na ku ma ras lo tsā ba bgyis te bsgyur ba yin te/ 'di la pad+ma dang gnyags kyi bar 'gyur du grags/ gsum pa ni/ phyisasu paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen byon skabs/ me rin chen mchog dang gnyags dz+nya na ku ma ra rnam pa gnyis las lo tsa ba byas nas bsgyur ba ste/ 'di la bi ma dang rma gnyags zung gi phyi 'gyur zhes grags so/ /'di'i mjug nas tshang mi 'dug kyang dpe gzhan pa ma rnyed/
